Beyond its immediate impact on programmable microassembly, and using laser-induced optofluidic actuation as a reduced-complexity experimental platform, our work points toward self-driving, AI-assisted optical manufacturing platforms in which natural language, differentiable objectives, and laser-based actuation are coupled into a reusable digital workflow.

title: Trinity: Unifying Class-Agnostic Terrain and Semantic Segmentation for Unstructured Outdoor Environments by Leveraging Synthetic Data
summary: Terrain understanding is fundamental for mobile robots operating in unstructured outdoor environments. Existing vision-based traversability estimation methods rely on robot-specific annotations or semantic class mappings, limiting transferability across platforms and requiring costly re-annotation when robot capabilities change, while standard semantic segmentation methods only focus on specific predefined classes, which do not capture the variety of terrains. In this work, we propose a transformer-based architecture that jointly performs class-specific semantic segmentation and class-agnostic terrain segmentation within a unified network, called Trinity. Terrain regions are segmented based solely on visual appearance, without predefined semantic labels or robot-dependent traversability scores. This formulation enables the learning of robot-agnostic visual terrain priors that can be combined with robot-specific experience for downstream tasks such as traversability estimation, visual odometry, and mission planning. To enable large-scale training with diverse terrain appearances, we extend the OAISYS simulator and introduce RUGDSynth, a synthetic dataset inspired by RUGD with class-agnostic terrain samples. Furthermore, we present the EXTerra Dataset, providing real-world images annotated with both class-specific and class-agnostic terrain labels. Experiments demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed task and the effectiveness of our joint segmentation approach in complex outdoor environments. Code and datasets will be released with this publication (after review).

title: Private & Common Information States in Decentralized Team Equilibrium via Dynamic Programming for POMDPs with Delayed Sharing
summary: Witsenhausen, in his seminal 1971 paper [1], introduced decentralized partially observable Markov decision problems (POMDPs), with multiple agents or controls operating under T-step delayed sharing information patterns. A fundamental problem in [1] is the identification of structural properties of optimal strategies that compress the information patterns into multiple information states. In this paper, we develop such structural properties of optimal strategies and associated dynamic programming (DP) equations, using the concept of decentralized sequential team equilibrium (a generalization of person-by-person optimality from static team theory). Within this framework, each strategy is assigned an individual value function conditioned on its delayed sharing information pattern, while the strategies of all other agents are held fixed. The resulting DP framework yields several new DP equations and characterizations of decentralized team equilibrium. Moreover, these DP equations exhibit fundamental properties analogous to those of centralized DP of POMDPs: the optimization in each agent's DP equations is performed over the agent's action space rather than over strategy spaces; each agent's multiple information states satisfy Markov recursions; and a separation principle holds. The DP equations reveal a structural compression property of optimal strategies: each agent compresses its delayed sharing information pattern into three components: 1) a private posterior distribution conditioned on the agent's delayed sharing information pattern, 2) a centralized posterior distribution conditioned on the common information shared by all agents, and 3) the agent's private information component. This structural result substantially extends Witsenhausen's Assertion 8 in [1].

title: Hurwitz Quaternion Multiplicative Quantization for KV Cache Compression
summary: We propose \textbf{Hurwitz Quaternion Multiplicative Quantization (HQMQ)}, a \textbf{calibration-free} method for KV cache compression of large language models. HQMQ treats each 4-element chunk of K or V as a quaternion and quantizes its unit direction to the \emph{product} $q_p \cdot q_s$, where $q_p$ ranges over the 24-element Hurwitz group $2T$ (the 24 vertices of the 24-cell on $S^3$, pairwise angle $60^\circ$) and $q_s$ ranges over a per-(layer, head) secondary codebook of $S$ \emph{random} unit quaternions. The multiplicative composition yields $24S$ effective codewords at $S$ stored parameters; random initialization suffices because left-multiplication is an $S^3$ isometry, so seeded codebooks vary in end-task ppl by $<1.5\%$. A per-batch median-multiplier outlier extraction step ($C{=}3$, no calibration) handles modern outlier-heavy architectures. We evaluate on five modern open models: Mistral-7B (dense MHA), Llama-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B (dense GQA), and gpt-oss-20b (sparse MoE). On Mistral-7B and Qwen3-8B, HQMQ matches fp16 within $0.02$--$0.03$ ppl points at $\sim$5 bits. On Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B, where naive int4 collapses to $10^4{+}$ ppl, HQMQ + Med3$\times$ recovers fp16 quality within $0.02$--$0.10$ ppl points at $\sim$5 bits. HQMQ Pareto-dominates naive int by $3$--$1900\times$ at matched bits across all five models, and downstream zero-shot accuracy matches fp16 at $3.79$ bits on Mistral. Against the strongest calibrated KV-quantization baseline, HQMQ at $3.79$ bits matches KIVI-4 ($\sim 4.5$ bits) within ${\sim}1$ pt on CoQA, $0.6$ pts on TruthfulQA, and $2.3$ pts on GSM8K, at $16\%$ fewer bits and without a calibration pass. At the storage level, HQMQ delivers up to $5.05\times$ KV compression, shrinking a Llama-3-70B 128k-context cache from 43 GB to 8.5 GB.

title: A Note on Boosting Uncloneable Encryption in Microcrypt
summary:
In this note, we consider the setting of uncloneable encryption satisfying uncloneable indistinguishability, a form of symmetric key encryption that prevents the cloning of ciphertexts in a very strong sense. Our goal is to minimize the assumptions under which (many-time secure) uncloneable encryption is known to exist, assuming the existence of an information-theoretic "uncloneable bit", i.e. a one-time secure uncloneable encryption scheme for one-bit messages. We observe that if a t -> t' uncloneable bit exists, then the following implications hold.
  1. If many-time secure symmetric key encryption exists, then many-time secure t -> t' uncloneable encryption for arbitrary-length messages exists. Since many-time secure uncloneable encryption implies many-time secure symmetric key encryption, this result is tight.
  2. If pseudorandom unitaries exist, then many-time secure t -> t' uncloneable encryption for arbitrary-length messages with identical copy security exists.
  These results together show that many-time secure uncloneable encryption may follow from concrete assumptions in "microcrypt", the world of unstructured quantum cryptography that plausibly exists even if P = NP.

title: Disentangling Language Roles in Multilingual LLM Task Execution
summary: Multilingual LLMs are increasingly used when instruction, source content, and required response languages do not coincide. Existing benchmarks have expanded multilingual instruction-following evaluation, but they rarely isolate these three roles within a fully crossed design. We introduce MTM-Bench, a controlled benchmark for language-conditioned task execution in which each instance is defined by a triplet \((L_{\text{instr}}, L_{\text{content}}, L_{\text{resp}})\). Across English, Spanish, and Chinese, MTM-Bench enumerates all 27 triplets and contains 2{,}430 instances per model across semantic reversal, final-state extraction, and language purity with update realization. We evaluate 20 frontier and open-weight LLMs using decomposed metrics for semantic correctness, target-language adherence, constraint satisfaction, contamination ratio, and joint success, with scoring validated by a targeted human audit. The fully crossed design reveals that degradation is organized by the role a language occupies in the task structure, not merely by mismatch count. The response-language role is the dominant axis of variation, and a single response-slot mismatch accounts for most degradation. The response-only and full-mismatch comparison suggests that mismatch count is not a monotonic predictor of difficulty, with model-level ordering varying across systems. Task families fail through distinct channels, showing that semantic correctness alone does not capture reliable multilingual task execution.

title: Faster Thermal Profiling of a Lunar Rover with Machine Learning Adapted Finite Difference Model
summary: Autonomous space systems operating in extreme thermal environments require accurate and efficient thermal modeling to support both pre-mission system design and onboard autonomy. For lunar rovers, large temperature gradients, radiative heat transfer, and variable surface conditions make reliable thermal prediction especially challenging. High-fidelity physics-based simulations provide accurate results but are computationally expensive, while simplified models and lookup-table approach often lack sufficient accuracy. Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) offers a promising alternative by combining data-driven models with embedded physical knowledge. This paper presents a PIML framework for thermal analysis of a simplified lunar rover with internal heat sources, where machine learning enables environment-adaptive coarse meshing. The proposed architecture integrates a transfer neural network (TNN) that adaptively determines 3D finite-difference nodalization based on thermal loads and initial conditions, enabling more accurate coarse-mesh calculations. A differentiable finite-difference thermal simulator is embedded within the framework to enforce physical consistency and support efficient training, while an upscaling layer reconstructs high-resolution temperature fields from the coarse-grid solution. The proposed PIML approach is evaluated against high-fidelity fine-mesh simulations, low-fidelity fixed coarse-mesh models, and a purely data-driven artificial neural network (ANN). Results show that the PIML framework improves prediction accuracy by 50% and 39% relative to the coarse-mesh physics model and ANN model, respectively, while maintaining physically consistent thermal distributions. Computationally, the framework is also 3x faster than high-fidelity simulations, demonstrating an effective balance between accuracy and efficiency for thermal modeling of lunar rover systems.

title: Carbon-Aware Mapping and Scheduling for Deadline-Constrained Workflows
comments: 29 pages, 11 figures, Preprint, to appear at Euro-Par'26
summary: As datacenters continue to grow in scale, their energy consumption and resulting carbon footprint have become pressing concerns. With the increasing share of renewable energy in a datacenter's mixed energy supply, shifting task execution to periods of high green-power availability is a promising strategy to reduce carbon emissions. However, in heterogeneous computing environments, the power consumption of compute nodes in a datacenter can also vary. In practice, workloads submitted to datacenters are often not isolated tasks, but entire workflows consisting of interdependent tasks with precedence constraints. A further challenge arises from the fact that carbon emission reductions must typically be achieved under strict workflow deadlines. In this work, we show that the problem posed by these challenges for the scheduler is NP-hard and admits no constant-factor approximation even for the uni-processor case. Motivated by this hardness, we present a novel algorithm CWM that combines carbon-aware mapping and scheduling to construct feasible solutions. Our approach integrates dynamic programming with efficient heuristics to exploit renewable energy availability and infrastructure heterogeneity. To assess the quality of the new algorithm, we evaluate it against the state-of-the-art approach CaWoSched and show that CWM achieves significant reductions in terms of carbon emissions in experiments. In particular, we are able to achieve a median carbon cost reduction of 42% over the best version of CaWoSched when the deadline is two times the makespan of a carbon-agnostic baseline. Note that CaWoSched itself already reduces the carbon-agnostic baseline by 36%.
comment: 29 pages, 11 figures, Preprint, to appear at Euro-Par'26

title: Cultural Fidelity in English-to-Hindi Translation: A Preservation-Fluency Frontier for Gender Recoverability
summary: Generative translation systems are cultural technologies because they decide how socially meaningful cues are rendered within culturally specific grammatical systems. We study one concrete notion of successful cultural translation: when an English source explicitly encodes gender, an English-to-Hindi translation should preserve the recoverability of that cue unless the source itself is ambiguous. We evaluate this criterion on a 37,345-instance benchmark spanning twelve categories and show that five systems frequently erase gender through ergative and honorific constructions. We then introduce two mechanism-aware inference-time interventions. The first, the Source-Aware Reranker (SAR), prefers candidates that avoid gender-neutralizing syntax. The second, the Phenomenon-Aware Reranker (PAR), preserves gender through targeted lexical marking even when ergative syntax remains. Across GPT-4o-mini and Sarvam, PAR improves target-subset accuracy from 11.07% to 54.47% and from 15.99% to 49.66%, respectively. Human evaluation shows that PAR increases gender preservation from 10.3% to 81.3%, but reduces mean fluency from 4.36 to 3.37. These findings place the two interventions on a preservation and fluency frontier rather than supporting a single dominant solution, and show how culturally situated generation can require explicit tradeoffs among fidelity, fluency, and stylistic naturalness.

title: Developing an Intelligent Job Recommendation System Using Semantic Retrieval and Explainable AI Techniques
comments: 11 pages, 5 figures, IEEE-style paper on semantic retrieval and explainable AI for intelligent job recommendation
summary: Online recruitment platforms require recommendation methods capable of retrieving relevant job opportunities from large and heterogeneous collections of job postings. Keyword-based search is efficient and interpretable, but it may fail to retrieve relevant postings when equivalent roles are expressed using different terminology. This study presents a metadata-driven job recommendation system that combines TF-IDF lexical matching, Sentence-BERT semantic retrieval, query-aware filtering, optional Cross-Encoder re-ranking, and explanation generation. The proposed system utilizes structured metadata fields including job title, company name, location, seniority level, job function, employment type, and industry without relying on full job descriptions or user interaction histories. Experiments conducted on a cleaned LinkedIn job posting dataset containing 31262 records demonstrate that the best hybrid configuration achieved a Precision at 10 score of 0.8032 and an nDCG at 10 score of 0.9496. Under the internal evaluation protocol, Cross-Encoder re-ranking improved Precision at 10 from 0.7896 to 0.7948 and nDCG at 10 from 0.9666 to 0.9739. These findings indicate that lexical and semantic retrieval techniques can be effectively combined to provide explainable job recommendations when only structured metadata is available.
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, IEEE-style paper on semantic retrieval and explainable AI for intelligent job recommendation

title: Transferable Reinforcement Learning via Probabilistic Latent Embeddings and Dynamic Policy Adaptation for Sim-to-Real Deployment
summary: Due to limited resources and public safety concerns, deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents for many cyber-physical systems (e.g., autonomous vehicles) are first trained in simulators. However, when deployed in real world environments, they often suffer from performance degradation or safety violations because of the inevitable Sim2Real gap. Existing zero-shot approaches, such as robust safe RL and domain randomization, mitigate this issue but typically at the cost of degraded performance or residual safety risks when experiencing unmodeled system dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework that enables safe and efficient policy transfer via probabilistic latent embeddings and dynamic policy adaptation. We consider a family of Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) under different environment contexts. By leveraging latent context variable in meta-RL, the proposed framework infers the latent representation of the environment from simulated experiences. Furthermore, it incorporates a distributional RL formulation, which allows risk levels of the deployed policy to be adjusted dynamically, based on the estimation accuracy of the latent context variable. This strategy promotes safety at the early deployment stage and improves efficiency through fast policy adaptation under the Sim2Real gap.

title: Design of a Real-time Asynchronous Monocular Odometry for Planetary Exploration
summary: We describe our preliminary design of a real-time asynchronous event-based monocular odometry for planetary exploration. Operating under strict computational constraints, planetary rovers frequently encounter complex, unpredictable environments that demand high-speed sensing and robustness to high dynamic range (HDR) lighting. Event cameras address these needs by reporting asynchronous, pixel-wise brightness changes with microsecond resolution, significantly reducing data bandwidth while maintaining robustness in extreme lighting conditions. We propose an approach based on an Error-State Kalman Filter (ESKF) that leverages this asynchronous event stream to continuously estimate camera ego-motion. The camera state is updated with every tracked position output generated by RATE, a real-time asynchronous feature tracker.

title: How the Optimizer Shapes Learned Solutions in Equivariant Neural Networks
comments: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Weight-Space Symmetries
summary: Equivariant neural networks encode geometric symmetries by construction, yet they are often difficult to optimize and can underperform less constrained architectures. A growing body of work addresses this through architectural modifications such as constraint relaxation or approximate equivariance, while the role of the optimizer remains comparatively underexplored. We study this direction by comparing Muon and Adam across several equivariant and geometric architectures under pointcloud and molecular learning settings. On ModelNet40, where the comparison is clearest, Muon consistently improves over Adam across all architectures considered. We then analyze the trained ModelNet40 checkpoints through Hessian estimates, loss surface visualizations, and spectral properties of learned weights and intermediate representations. The checkpoints reached by Muon have larger Hessian curvature summaries but more regular loss surfaces, and their learned weights and representations have higher stable and effective ranks. These observations suggest that the interaction between optimizer design and geometric inductive bias deserves further attention from the community.
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Weight-Space Symmetries

title: Explanations as Dialogues: Toward Human-Centered Conversational Explainable AI
comments: To be published in the ACM Conversational User Interfaces (CUI)'26 Conference as Provocation
summary: As AI systems become increasingly conversational, a gap emerges wherein explanations are studied as static artifacts, yet in practice, are experienced as dialogue. In this provocation, we argue that the conversational layer around an explanation is not incidental to its effectiveness, but a critical constituent. Drawing on three illustrative scenarios, we invite the CUI community to study explanations as interactive, conversational exchanges shaped by timing, tone, persona and conversational history, and introduce our vision for Human-Centered Conversational XAI (HC2XAI).
comment: To be published in the ACM Conversational User Interfaces (CUI)'26 Conference as Provocation

title: Silent Consent, Persistent Risk: Android Permission Groups and Custom Permissions
comments: 24 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. To appear in the Proceedings of the 23rd Conference on Detection of Intrusions and Malware & Vulnerability Assessment (DIMVA 2026), July 1-3, 2026, Chania, Greece. Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
summary: Android's permission system is designed to balance usability with informed consent, yet two legacy mechanisms still undermine that balance in Android 16: (i) permission groups that silently auto-grant new permissions within a group after a user's initial approval, and (ii) normal-level custom permissions that are auto-granted at install and enable cross-app access with no user visibility. We conduct a longitudinal analysis of 19.3 million APKs spanning 5.97 million unique apps (distinct package identifiers) from the AndroZoo repository, combined with on-device validation on Android 16. Among 2,244,575 multi-version apps, 381,026 (17%) silently gain permissions within already-granted groups. Using VirusTotal detections with primary threshold t=20, apps flagged as malware expand within groups at a higher rate than benign apps (odds ratio = 1.35, p < 0.001); the association holds across every tested threshold and concentrates in permission-heavy apps (OR = 2.06 in the top quartile). We also identify 307 cross-developer normal-custom-permission pairs that expose contacts, SMS, location, authentication credentials, user identity, and medical records to unrelated apps without any user prompt. A lightweight prototype built on public Android APIs recorded 23 silent expansion events across 13 apps during a 96-day single-device pilot, showing that update-time transparency is reachable without OS modification. Our results show that consent erosion persists despite a decade of platform hardening and affects apps ranging from obscure utilities to widely deployed and pre-installed software.
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. To appear in the Proceedings of the 23rd Conference on Detection of Intrusions and Malware & Vulnerability Assessment (DIMVA 2026), July 1-3, 2026, Chania, Greece. Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)

title: Aligning LLMs with Human Uncertainty: A Beta-Bernoulli Calibrator for LLM Forecasting
summary: Probabilistic forecasting estimates the likelihood of uncertain future events. To improve LLM forecasting, existing methods typically learn from binary outcomes to output verbalized forecasts. However, while aggregated human forecasts contain rich information in both the crowd probability estimate and the degree of agreement among forecasters, how to utilize these signals remains underexplored. To address this, we propose the Beta-Bernoulli Calibrator (BBC), which converts an initial point estimate forecast from any model into a distribution over event likelihood, using supervision from both binary outcomes and human forecasts. BBC models event likelihood $p \sim \text{Beta}(α, β)$ and outcome $y \sim \text{Bernoulli}(p)$, with the mean as the calibrated point forecast and the variance as the epistemic uncertainty. Our results show that BBC generally provides better calibrated and more accurate forecasts than both traditional post-hoc calibration methods and models fine-tuned specifically for forecasting, while remaining lightweight and having good generalization. We also show that the epistemic uncertainty captured by BBC is a more reliable predictor of forecasting error than verbalized confidence.

title: When do complex-valued neural networks help? A study of representation, geometry, and optimization
summary: Complex-valued Neural Networks (CVNNs) are often motivated by domains where information is naturally encoded in magnitude and phase. Yet complex-valued inputs alone do not determine when complex arithmetic improves learning: the label signal may lie in amplitude, phase, their coupling, or a symmetry that real-valued models can also represent under suitable coordinates. We study this through a representation-first evaluation of CVNNs against Cartesian real, polar, phase-only, magnitude-only, parameter-matched real, and FLOP-matched real baselines. Across synthetic RF tasks, complex representations are useful but not universally superior. PSK-only tasks favor phase-aware and complex-valued models, QAM-only tasks favor magnitude-based models, mixed PSK+QAM gives only a small complex-valued advantage, and unseen carrier-phase rotations break coordinate-dependent models without augmentation. Similar patterns appear beyond RF: in quantum-wavefunction prediction, momentum is invisible to $|ψ|$ but recoverable from phase, while EEG analytic-signal experiments show that phase locking, amplitude bursts, and phase-amplitude coupling each favor different coordinate views. We also identify a benchmarking artifact on RadioML 2018.01A. Under matched-shared-trial selection, a CReLU complex model exceeds the best real baseline by 22.94 PP; under independent per-family tuning on the same data and 16-trial search space, the gap collapses to 2.46 PP. Gradient analysis traces the inflated gap to high-learning-rate first-step instability in real baselines, while complex parameter coupling distributes the loss signal more robustly. A learning-rate $\times$ activation factorial confirms the failure is primarily hyperparameter-driven. Overall, CVNNs are best viewed as structured inductive biases whose gains depend on representation, symmetry, and optimization, not as universally superior architectures.

title: Backdoor Attacks on Fault Detection and Localization in Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) integrate sensing, communication, computation, and control to support critical infrastructure, including smart grids, industrial automation, and control systems. In the electrical utility domain, various controllers are used in CPS to ensure the system detects and recovers from faults, such as voltage fluctuations, and to perform load balancing in distribution systems. Machine learning- and deep learning-based fault detection and localization frameworks have recently gained significant attention in CPS for their ability to identify anomalies and operational failures in real time. However, these intelligent models are vulnerable to adversarial machine learning attacks, particularly backdoor attacks. In a backdoor attack, an adversary injects malicious patterns into the training data so that the model behaves normally most of the time but produces attacker-controlled outputs when triggered by specific patterns. This paper investigates the threat of backdoor attacks against fault detection and localization mechanisms in recent ML pipelines used in modern CPS systems. We define these threats and explore how they can be realized by designing triggers and evaluating their success in the CPS domain. Our experiments show the attack is successful even with 10\% of poisoning.

title: Heterogeneous Parallelism for Multimodal Large Language Model Training
summary: Foundation model training is becoming multimodal, from post-training pipelines to large-scale pretraining. As modality coverage broadens, context windows grow, and encoder LLM scales diverge, a single LLM-centric TP/CP/PP/DP/EP layout increasingly limits throughput. This coupling forces encoders to inherit LLM-driven sharding and placement choices that can add communication, limit encoder parallelism, or constrain the LLM schedule; the mismatch is most pronounced at long contexts, where LLM context parallelism is needed for the fused multimodal sequence but encoder inputs remain bounded. We present heterogeneous parallelism for multimodal large language model training, an abstraction that lets modules in one end-to-end graph use independent layouts and rank placements, supporting colocated execution on shared GPUs and non-colocated execution on disjoint rank sets. The key challenge is preserving boundary tensor semantics across independent layouts: forward activations must be materialized for the destination layout, while backward gradients must be routed back to the source layout. We address this with boundary communicators that implement forward and backward layout transforms, plus scheduling extensions for both placement modes. We evaluate optimized homogeneous, colocated heterogeneous, and non-colocated heterogeneous configurations across multimodal workloads and GPU scales to characterize when added layout and placement freedom exposes a better operating point. Across this sweep, colocated heterogeneity improves TFLOPS/GPU by up to 49.3%, while non-colocated heterogeneity improves aggregate token throughput by up to 13.0% and TFLOPS/GPU by up to 9.6%. We validate loss convergence parity against homogeneous baselines and release the system as an open-source Megatron-LM extension.

title: A Structure-Preserving PML-Domain-Embedding Method for Acoustic Wave Scattering by Moving Objects
summary: We develop a structure-preserving computational framework for acoustic wave scattering by moving objects, comprising a new PML-domain-embedding model and a compatible numerical approximation. The model couples a perfectly matched layer (PML), used to truncate the acoustic wave equation, with a domain-embedding formulation that represents moving objects on a fixed computational domain. The resulting PML-domain-embedding (PML-DE) system enables moving-boundary scattering problems to be solved without remeshing. Using matched asymptotic expansions, we show that the diffuse-interface formulation converges to the corresponding sharpinterface system as the interface thickness tends to zero. We then construct an energy-dissipationrate-preserving finite-difference scheme for the PML-DE system. To improve computational efficiency, the scheme is combined with hierarchical local refinement informed by the moving-object location, the fixed PML region, and the evolving wave dynamics, all within the fixed computational domain. Numerical experiments demonstrate the accuracy of the computed scattering solutions, the effectiveness of the absorbing layer and object-embedding strategy, and the efficiency of the adaptive algorithm. The proposed framework provides a practical and robust computational approach for engineering applications involving complex acoustic wave-scattering problems.

title: Behavioural Analysis of Alignment Faking
summary: Alignment faking (AF) refers to a model strategically complying with a training objective to avoid behavioural modification while preserving its deployment preferences. Understanding when and why AF arises matters as models grow better at distinguishing training from deployment. Prior work finds AF fragile, prompt-sensitive, and model-dependent, leaving its underlying drivers unclear. We study AF in a controlled, minimal setup that isolates its core components, and observe it across a wider range of models than previously reported, including small-scale models. We identify three separable drivers -- values, goal guarding, and sycophancy -- and show via targeted prompt ablations and activation steering that each independently modulates AF behaviour. Our results indicate AF is more widespread than previously reported and that its occurrence is predictable from situational cues and measurable model tendencies such as baseline sycophancy and stated values. The decomposition suggests concrete directions for detecting and mitigating AF in future models.

title: Decoupled Intelligence: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Controllable Traffic Scenario Generation in SUMO
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) with microscopic traffic simulation offers a promising path toward autonomous urban planning and intelligent transportation analysis. However, existing monolithic agent architectures often struggle with the complexity of end-to-end simulation workflows, leading to reasoning failures, parameter inconsistency, and a lack of systematic state management. This paper proposes a novel multi-agent collaborative framework designed to automate the entire lifecycle of traffic simulation in SUMO (Simulation of Urban Mobility). Our approach decouples the simulation pipeline into specialized roles, including Planner, Builder, Demand, Runner, and Analyst, coordinated by a high-level reasoning engine. We introduce a state-persistent Orchestrator leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to ensure seamless data handover and environmental consistency across distributed agent actions. This architecture enables a robust closed-loop refinement process, where simulation outcomes are iteratively analyzed and optimized to satisfy user-defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Experimental results through role ablation studies demonstrate that the proposed multi-agent framework significantly enhances task success rates and parameter accuracy compared to single-agent baselines. Furthermore, case studies on real-world network extraction and traffic optimization highlight the system's capability to bridge the gap between high-level natural language intent and low-level simulation execution.

title: Tensor Memory: Fixed-Size Recurrent State for Long-Horizon Transformers
summary: Transformers process images and videos by flattening space and time into long token sequences. While attention and KV caching preserve past features, their memory grows with sequence length and they lack an explicit, persistent spatial state, making long-horizon video understanding and occlusion-sensitive reasoning difficult. We propose Tensor Memory, a lightweight module that augments Transformer blocks with a fixed-size recurrent 3D memory tensor: tokens write into a voxel grid via a differentiable soft write that deposits content as a Gaussian-weighted volume around a predicted continuous 3D location, the memory is updated with an efficient local interaction operator and gated recurrent dynamics, and tokens read back context via continuous sampling with gated residual fusion. Because the memory tensor has a constant size, Tensor Memory decouples state capacity from input length while preserving a spatial inductive bias. We evaluate the module on standard language, image, and video benchmarks and on a controlled toy diagnostic suite designed to isolate when persistent state is beneficial; it integrates with standard Transformer training pipelines and can be attached to or removed from existing blocks without other architectural changes.

title: Test-Time Collective Action: Proxy-Based Perturbations for Correcting Algorithmic Harms
summary: When machine learning systems under-perform for particular subgroups, affected users typically have no way to correct these disparities without relying on platform-level fixes. Existing approaches to algorithmic fairness rely on provider-centric approaches to correct these failures, leaving users with no external lever when faced with harm. Recent work in Algorithmic Collective Action shows that coordinated users can steer an algorithmic system toward a collective goal, but the existing mechanisms require the provider to retrain on the collective's modified data which users may not have control over. We propose Test-Time Collective Action (TTCA), a framework through which a group of users who share query access to the platform, can correct disparities affecting under-served subgroup without participating in the platform's training loop. We implement this through a proxy-based mechanism where the collective pools query access to a black-box API to extract a proxy of the platform, then optimizes a per-class universal perturbation against the proxy. Each member applies this perturbation to their own inputs at submission time, requiring no cooperation from the platform. We empirically evaluate the mechanism on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and FairFace, showing that modestly-sized collectives close most of the subgroup accuracy gap, transfer across architectures (a small proxy can attack a larger platform), and improve worst-group accuracy, equal-opportunity gap, and disparate impact. A query-budget analysis comparing a per-user black-box attack baseline shows that pooling is cheaper than each subgroup member attacking alone. Test-time collective action thus offers corrective intervention to users when platform-side remediation is unavailable or delayed.

title: TRACES: Proactive Safety Auditing for Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Trajectory-State Modeling
summary: LLM agents increasingly operate through multi-turn tool use and environment interaction, where safety risks often emerge from intermediate steps long before they surface in the final outcome. Reactive auditing is therefore insufficient: post-hoc diagnosis frequently misses the chance to flag risks while they are unfolding. We propose TRACES, a representation-based proactive auditor that learns prefix-level trajectory risk states from the hidden representations of an observer LLM. TRACES induces latent mechanism features from step representations and models their temporal evolution to estimate whether a partial trajectory is drifting toward unsafe behavior. To sidestep the cost and ambiguity of step-level risk annotation, TRACES is trained with weak trajectory-level supervision while still producing dense prefix-level risk estimates. Across multiple agent safety benchmarks, TRACES improves both full-trajectory safety prediction and proactive risk discrimination. Our analyses further suggest that these risk states can help train a safer agent, highlighting the broader potential of proactive auditing for long-horizon agent safety.

title: SOLANET: Distributed Neighbor Graph Construction on GPU-Accelerated Systems
summary:
Neighbor graphs capture relationships among data points and are widely used in data analytics and AI workloads. Many studies have explored approximate construction methods for single-node systems, including GPUs. However, extending this to distributed systems for larger data and further acceleration remains challenging due to irregular computation patterns.
  We present SOLANET, a GPU-accelerated distributed neighbor graph construction toolkit. SOLANET first constructs local graphs on each GPU after data partitioning and then refines them via approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) searches over remote graphs pulled from other GPUs using MPI one-sided operations. SOLANET also provides a lock-free single-GPU neighbor graph construction algorithm for AMD GPUs.
  Our single-GPU implementation outperforms a state-of-the-art GPU-based approximate neighbor graph construction implementation across multiple datasets on a single MI300A APU. Furthermore, SOLANET demonstrates 11X speedup from 32 to 512 APUs for 1 billion data points and 6.9x speedup from 64 to 512 APUs for 2 billion points.

title: Structure over Pixels: Learning Variable-Length Visual Programs
summary: Discrete visual tokenizers translate images into ordered sequences of codes, providing a natural representation for structural description of scenes. Yet existing adaptive tokenizers either require post-hoc search or select among a discrete set of pre-trained rates, rather than learning a continuous per-image sequence length coupled to the model and scene, and they typically train against pixel reconstruction, emphasizing texture rather than structure. We propose STROP, a discrete visual tokenizer architecture that forms structural scene representations and simultaneously learns how long an image's visual program should be. Using a four-phase curriculum supervised by local rate--distortion probes against frozen DINOv3 features, STROP optimizes a dedicated length head that estimates the active prefix length in a single forward pass. By bypassing pixel-level reconstruction gradients, the codebook is shaped entirely by the quality of higher-level latent representations. Program length grows with scene complexity, and signs of compositional structure emerge both in downstream dense-prediction transfer and in direct inspection of the learned code vocabulary.

title: Simulation-Informed Diffusion for Decentralized Multi-robot Motion Planning
summary: Decentralized multi-robot motion planning requires each robot to generate collision-free trajectories from local observations, without global sensing or reliable communication. However, most existing planners, whether classical or learning-based, generate trajectories from a static snapshot of the local observation, which limits their ability to anticipate the future behavior of neighboring robots. This limitation is critical as the number of robots increases and the environment becomes more cluttered. To overcome this challenge, this paper introduces Simulation-Informed Diffusion (SID), a decentralized framework built on constraint-aware diffusion models (CADM). SID first uses CADM to simulate the future trajectories of neighboring robots from their currently observed states, and then uses the same CADM to plan each robot's own trajectory under safety constraints informed by these simulations. Crucially, the accurate simulation of neighbors enables a minimal communication scheme that triggers coordination only when necessary in highly congested scenarios. Experiments across diverse environments show that SID consistently outperforms baseline methods in terms of planning effectiveness and constraint satisfaction, and scales to scenarios with 108 robots and 160 obstacles.

AI.title_translation: 用于分布式多机器人运动规划的模拟告知扩散方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SID的分布式多机器人运动规划框架，通过扩散模型模拟邻近机器人的未来轨迹来辅助自身安全规划，在减少通信需求的同时，实现了高密度场景下的高效避障。
AI.motivation: 在分布式多机器人运动规划中，现有规划器主要依赖局部观测的静态快照来生成轨迹，缺乏预测邻近机器人未来行为的能力，这导致在机器人数量增加和环境拥挤时规划效果变差。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“模拟告知扩散”（Simulation-Informed Diffusion, SID）的分布式框架。该框架基于约束感知扩散模型（CADM），首先利用CADM根据当前观测状态模拟邻近机器人的未来轨迹，然后使用相同的CADM在这些模拟轨迹所构成的安全约束下规划自身的运动轨迹。此外，还引入了一种仅在高度拥挤场景下触发的极简通信协调方案。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SID在规划有效性和约束满足度方面均持续优于基线方法，并成功扩展至包含108个机器人和160个障碍物的复杂高密度场景。
AI.conclusion: SID框架通过高精度的邻近机器人轨迹模拟和基于扩散模型的安全约束规划，显著提升了分布式多机器人运动规划的性能与安全性，并在极简通信下展现出极强的可扩展性。
AI.translation: 分布式多机器人运动规划要求每个机器人根据局部观测生成无碰撞轨迹，而无需全局感知或可靠的通信。然而，大多数现有的规划器（无论是传统的还是基于学习的）都是根据局部观测的静态快照来生成轨迹，这限制了它们预测邻居机器人未来行为的能力。随着机器人数量的增加和环境变得更加拥挤，这一局限性变得至关重要。为了应对这一挑战，本文引入了模拟告知扩散（Simulation-Informed Diffusion, SID），这是一个建立在约束感知扩散模型（CADM）之上的分布式框架。SID首先使用CADM根据邻近机器人当前观测到的状态来模拟其未来的轨迹，然后使用相同的CADM在这些模拟所告知的安全约束下规划机器人自身的轨迹。关键是，对邻近机器人的准确模拟实现了一种极简的通信方案，该方案仅在高度拥挤的场景中必要时才触发协调。在不同环境中的实验表明，SID在规划有效性和约束满足度方面始终优于基线方法，并可扩展到包含108个机器人和160个障碍物的场景。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于分布式多机器人运动规划的新型框架——模拟告知扩散（SID）。针对现有方法无法有效预测邻近机器人未来行为的缺陷，SID利用约束感知扩散模型（CADM）首先模拟邻近机器人的未来轨迹，随后在这些模拟产生的安全约束下规划自身的轨迹。该方法还支持极简的通信机制，仅在高度拥挤时触发协调。实验表明，该方法在规划效率和约束满足上表现优异，且具有极强的扩展性。
AI.keywords: 运动规划, 分布式系统, 扩散模型, 多机器人系统, 轨迹模拟
AI.comments: 本文创造性地将约束感知扩散模型（CADM）应用于分布式多机器人运动规划中，通过“先模拟他人、再规划自己”的逻辑，有效解决了传统方法难以预测动态邻居行为的痛点。其最大亮点在于利用高精度模拟实现了极简的通信机制，这对于实际应用中通信带宽受限的分布式系统极具价值。不过，扩散模型本身的计算开销较大，其在实际机器人硬件上的实时运行表现（如推理延迟）仍需进一步关注。

title: AURA: Asymptotically Optimal Uncertainty-Robust Replanning Algorithm for Kinodynamic Systems
summary: Sampling-based motion planners offer a practical and scalable approach to kinodynamic motion planning, notably for high-dimensional, underactuated, or non-holonomic systems. However, these planners are typically used offline, requiring execution to begin only after the trajectory has been computed. In addition, the planned trajectory may not be accurately tracked in the presence of motion uncertainty, leading to deviations from the nominal solution. In this work, these limitations were addressed within a unified framework, \method, an asymptotically-optimal meta-planner framework that improves both path quality and tracking performance during execution. In addition to the main execution thread, this framework comprises a replanning method that continuously explores the state space and refines the trajectory during execution, and an optimization process that refines future control inputs to reduce tracking error. Together, these components enable \method to leverage asymptotically optimal planning online while improving execution accuracy under uncertainty. The proposed approach is evaluated in both simulation and real-world environments across multiple systems, demonstrating consistent improvements in trajectory quality, tracking accuracy, and overall performance compared with baseline methods.

AI.title_translation: AURA：适用于动力学约束系统的渐近最优不确定性鲁棒重规划算法
AI.tldr: 提出AURA框架，通过在线重规划和控制优化，实现了动力学系统在运动不确定性下的渐近最优在线轨迹规划与精确跟踪。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于采样的动力学运动规划器通常只能离线运行（需要计算完轨迹才执行），且在存在运动不确定性时，实际执行轨迹容易偏离规划的标称轨迹。
AI.method: 提出AURA（渐近最优不确定性鲁棒重规划算法）框架。该框架除了主执行线程外，还包含一个在执行期间持续探索状态空间并精细化轨迹的重规划方法，以及一个通过优化未来控制输入来减少跟踪误差的控制优化过程。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界的多系统测试中，该方法在轨迹质量、跟踪精度和整体性能上均表现出相比基线方法一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: AURA框架能够实现在线渐近最优规划，并显著提高动力学系统在运动不确定性环境下的执行精度与整体性能。
AI.translation: 基于采样的运动规划器为动力学运动规划提供了一种实用且可扩展的方法，特别是对于高维、欠驱动或非完整系统。然而，这些规划器通常在离线状态下使用，要求仅在计算出轨迹后才开始执行。此外，在存在运动不确定性的情况下，规划的轨迹可能无法被精确跟踪，从而导致偏离标称解。在这项工作中，这些限制在一个统一的框架——AURA中得到了解决。AURA是一个渐近最优的元规划器框架，它在执行过程中同时提高了路径质量和跟踪性能。除了主执行线程外，该框架还包括一个在执行期间持续探索状态空间并精细化轨迹的重规划方法，以及一个精细化未来控制输入以减少跟踪误差的优化过程。这些组件共同使AURA能够在在线状态下利用渐近最优规划，同时提高不确定性下的执行精度。所提出的方法在多个系统的仿真和真实世界环境中进行了评估，展示了与基线方法相比在轨迹质量、跟踪精度和整体性能上的持续改进。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为AURA的渐近最优元规划器框架，旨在解决动力学系统离线规划和运动不确定性导致轨迹偏差的局限性。该框架通过在线重规划机制持续优化轨迹，并结合控制输入优化过程以减少跟踪误差。仿真和实物实验表明，该方法显著提升了多系统在不确定性环境下的轨迹质量和执行精度。
AI.keywords: 动力学运动规划, 在线重规划, 不确定性鲁棒, 渐近最优, 轨迹优化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将渐近最优的规划与实时控制优化结合在统一框架中，有效解决了不确定性环境下的在线动力学规划难题。然而，摘要中未详细讨论该算法在高维复杂场景下的计算延迟和实时性保障，这可能是其在实际高频控制应用中的主要局限。

title: CiteCheck: Retrieval-Grounded Detection of LLM Citation Hallucinations in Scientific Text
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate scientific reports, but they can produce references that appear plausible while containing corrupted metadata or pointing to papers that do not exist. We introduce CiteCheck, a hybrid framework for citation hallucination detection that verifies whether a citation corresponds to a real scholarly work and whether its metadata is faithful to that work. CiteCheck retrieves candidate publications from external scholarly sources, compares the citation against the retrieved candidate using a structured LLM verifier, and maps verifier scores into three labels: Exact, Minor, and Major. We also construct a 982-citation physics benchmark with controlled corruptions that capture both subtle metadata drift and fully fabricated references. On the held-out test set, CiteCheck achieves 88.7 macro-F1 and 88.9% accuracy, outperforming GPT, Claude, and Gemini baselines, including web-search and few-shot variants. These results show that reliable citation verification benefits from combining scholarly retrieval, structured LLM-based comparison, and calibrated decision rules.

AI.title_translation: CiteCheck：基于检索的科学文本中大语言模型引用幻觉检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出CiteCheck框架，通过结合学术文献检索与结构化大模型验证，有效检测科学文本中的引用幻觉，并在物理学基准上取得了88.9%的优异准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）在生成科学报告时，容易产生看似合理但包含错误元数据（如作者、年份、期刊等损坏）或指向不存在论文的虚构引用（即引用幻觉）。
AI.method:
提出了一种名为CiteCheck的混合框架，其工作流程包括：
1. 从外部学术资源中检索候选文献；
2. 使用结构化LLM验证器将待测引用与检索到的候选文献进行对比；
3. 将验证分数映射为三个标签（Exact、Minor、Major）。
此外，团队还构建了一个包含982个物理学引用的基准数据集，其中包含受控的元数据损坏和完全虚构的引用。
AI.result: 在保留的测试集上，CiteCheck实现了88.7的macro-F1值和88.9%的准确率，性能优于包括GPT、Claude、Gemini在内的主流大模型基线（包括它们的网页搜索和少样本变体）。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的引用验证能够通过结合学术文献检索、结构化LLM对比以及校准的决策规则来获得显著提升。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于生成科学报告，但它们可能会产生看似合理但包含损坏元数据或指向不存在论文的引用。我们引入了CiteCheck，这是一个用于引用幻觉检测的混合框架，它能够验证引用是否对应于真实的学术著作，以及其元数据是否忠实于该著作。CiteCheck从外部学术源检索候选出版物，使用结构化LLM验证器将引用与检索到的候选进行对比，并将验证器分数映射为三个标签：Exact（准确）、Minor（轻微）和Major（严重）。我们还构建了一个包含982个引用的物理学基准，其中包含受控的损坏，以捕获细微的元数据漂移和完全虚构的引用。在保留测试集上，CiteCheck实现了88.7的macro-F1和88.9%的准确率，优于GPT、Claude和Gemini基线，包括网页搜索和少样本变体。这些结果表明，可靠的引用验证受益于学术检索、结构化LLM对比和校准决策规则的结合。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM在生成科学文本时产生的引用幻觉问题，提出了CiteCheck混合验证框架。该框架通过从外部学术源检索文献，并利用结构化LLM验证器对比生成的引用与真实文献，从而对引用质量进行三分类评估。在包含982个引用的物理学基准测试中，CiteCheck的准确率达到了88.9%，显著优于GPT、Claude和Gemini等主流基线模型，证明了结合学术检索与结构化大模型对比在引用验证中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 引用幻觉检测, 大语言模型, 学术检索, 科学文本, 幻觉验证
AI.comments:
**创新性**：CiteCheck将外部学术文献检索与结构化LLM验证相结合，并能对引用错误进行细粒度（Exact, Minor, Major）的分类，这相比于传统的二分类检测更为实用。
**重要性**：大语言模型在学术写作中产生的引用幻觉是阻碍其广泛应用的一大痛点，该研究提供了一个有效的自动化验证方案和高质量的物理学基准。
**局限性**：该方法高度依赖外部学术检索源的质量，且目前仅在物理学领域的数据集上进行了验证，其在其他学科（如医学、人文社科等）的泛化能力仍有待检验。

title: Cross-Entropy Games and Frost Training
summary: We present Frost Training, a method for improving Monte Carlo-based policy optimization for a large family of LLM-as-a-judge tasks called Cross-Entropy Games. The key idea is to exploit the gradient of the reward function in embedding space. This signal is used in the Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) jailbreaking technique; we demonstrate for the first time that it can also be used to boost model training. We validate our method using GRPO training for maximum-likelihood infilling. Frost Training improves the model's ability to generate high-scoring outputs, reaching higher maximum scores in a best-of-k setting, and does so at an increased speed.

AI.title_translation: 交叉熵博弈与 Frost 训练
AI.tldr: 本文提出 Frost Training 方法，首次将越狱技术中使用的嵌入空间奖励梯度用于大模型策略优化训练，显著提升了生成质量并加快了训练速度。
AI.motivation: 旨在改进一类被称为“交叉熵博弈”（Cross-Entropy Games）的大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）任务中，基于蒙特卡洛的策略优化方法。
AI.method: 提出 Frost Training 方法，其核心思想是利用嵌入空间中奖励函数的梯度。该梯度信号曾用于 GCG 越狱技术，本文首次将其用于加速和改进模型训练，并使用 GRPO 训练在最大似然填充任务上进行了验证。
AI.result: Frost Training 显著提高了模型生成高分输出的能力，在 best-of-k 设置中达到了更高的最高分，并且加快了训练速度。
AI.conclusion: 利用嵌入空间中奖励函数的梯度信号，可以显著提升大语言模型在交叉熵博弈任务中的策略优化效率和生成质量。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 Frost Training，这是一种用于改进被称为“交叉熵博弈”（Cross-Entropy Games）的一大类大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）任务中基于蒙特卡洛的策略优化的方法。其核心思想是利用嵌入空间中奖励函数的梯度。该信号常用于贪婪坐标梯度（GCG）越狱技术；我们首次证明了它也可以用来促进模型训练。我们使用最大似然填充（maximum-likelihood infilling）的 GRPO 训练验证了我们的方法。Frost Training 提高了模型生成高分输出的能力，在 best-of-k 设置中达到了更高的最高分数，并且提高了训练速度。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为 Frost Training 的新方法，旨在优化大语言模型在“交叉熵博弈”任务中的蒙特卡洛策略。该方法首次将常用于 GCG 越狱技术的嵌入空间奖励函数梯度引入到模型训练中。实验表明，在 GRPO 训练框架下，该方法不仅提升了模型生成高分结果的能力，还显著提高了训练速度。
AI.keywords: Frost 训练, 交叉熵博弈, 策略优化, 奖励函数梯度, GRPO 训练
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将原本用于对抗性攻击（如 GCG 越狱技术）的嵌入空间奖励函数梯度，首次创新性地应用于正向的模型训练（策略优化）中，实现了变废为宝。其局限性在于，摘要中仅提及在最大似然填充任务上进行了验证，该方法在更广泛、更复杂的 LLM 任务上的泛化能力和计算开销仍需进一步观察。

title: Hierarchical Prompt-Domain Control and Learning for Resource-Constrained Agentic Language Models
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed inside agentic systems, where they must follow structured protocols, adapt to evolving states, and operate under memory, latency, and cost constraints. In such regimes, prompt extension is unreliable: growing contexts can push compact models outside their effective prompt domain, while deployment-time fine-tuning remains limited by scarce data and compute. We propose a hierarchical control-and-learning framework in which a compact model is first distilled to learn the required output schema, then supervised online by an oracle-controller loop. The controller monitors protocol validity and semantic performance, projects accumulated histories into a feasible prompt domain, and triggers lightweight oracle-supervised fine-tuning under drift. This separates schema learning for communication compatibility from semantic adaptation for task-level correction. We formalize prompt-domain feasibility and attention-induced saturation, motivating control of the effective prompt state rather than reliance on nominal context length. Using Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization as a controlled sequential testbed, we characterize a core deployment failure mode and show improved reliability and cost-efficiency over non-hierarchical, distillation-only, and non-distilled baselines.

AI.title_translation: 资源受限智能体语言模型的分层提示域控制与学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层控制与学习框架，通过将紧凑模型的架构蒸馏与在线神谕控制器监控相结合，实现了提示域的主动控制与轻量级微调，显著提升了资源受限智能体模型的运行可靠性与成本效益。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的智能体系统中部署大语言模型时，模型必须在内存、延迟和成本约束下遵循结构化协议并适应动态状态。然而，现有的提示词扩展方法不可靠（长上下文会导致紧凑模型超出其有效提示域），而部署期微调又受限于稀缺的数据和算力。
AI.method: 提出一种分层控制与学习框架：首先通过蒸馏使紧凑模型掌握所需的输出架构（用于通信兼容性）；然后引入在线“神谕-控制器”循环进行实时监督，该控制器负责监控协议有效性与语义表现、将历史上下文投影到可行提示域内，并在发生漂移时触发轻量级的神谕监督在线微调（用于任务级纠错）。
AI.result: 在多保真贝叶斯优化（Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization）的控制顺序测试平台上，该方法成功刻画了核心部署失效模式，并在高可靠性和高成本效益方面显著优于非分层、仅蒸馏以及未蒸馏的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功形式化了提示域可行性与注意力饱和问题，表明控制有效提示状态比单纯依赖名义上下文长度更为重要。所提出的分层控制与学习框架有效解决了资源受限智能体模型在长上下文下的失效问题，提升了部署的可靠性与经济性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署在智能体系统中，在这些系统中，它们必须遵循结构化协议、适应不断演变的状态，并在内存、延迟和成本限制下运行。在这些机制下，提示扩展是不可靠的：不断增长的上下文可能会使紧凑模型超出其有效的提示域，而部署时的微调仍受到稀缺数据和计算资源的限制。我们提出了一种分层控制与学习框架，其中首先对紧凑模型进行蒸馏以学习所需的输出架构，然后由在线神谕-控制器（oracle-controller）循环进行监督。该控制器监控协议的有效性和语义性能，将累积的历史投影到可行的提示域中，并在发生漂移时触发轻量级的神谕监督微调。这实现了用于通信兼容性的架构学习与用于任务级纠错的语义自适应的分离。我们形式化了提示域可行性和注意力诱导的饱和，激发了对有效提示状态的控制，而不是依赖名义上的上下文长度。使用多保真贝叶斯优化作为控制顺序测试平台，我们刻画了核心部署失效模式，并展示了相比于非分层、仅蒸馏和未蒸馏的基线方法，该方法在可靠性和成本效益上的提升。
AI.summary: 本文针对资源受限智能体系统中的紧凑语言模型，提出了一种分层控制与学习框架。该框架通过先蒸馏输出架构、再利用在线神谕控制器进行状态监控和轻量级微调，实现了通信架构学习与语义任务自适应的分离，从而在控制提示状态的同时，提高了模型在约束环境下的运行可靠性和成本效益。
AI.keywords: 智能体语言模型, 提示域控制, 分层学习, 资源受限部署, 贝叶斯优化
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于提出了“提示域控制”的概念，并形式化了注意力饱和问题，通过分层框架将格式规范（架构学习）与语义纠错（自适应）进行解耦，为资源受限环境下的智能体部署提供了新颖且实用的解决方案。其局限性在于，在线神谕-控制器循环的引入可能会在实际运行中带来额外的检测延迟，且对“神谕”的依赖在复杂多变的任务中可能存在泛化瓶颈。

title: Joint Optimization of Relevance and Engagement in Multi-Task Ranking for E-Commerce with Efficient LLM Supervision
summary: Optimizing industrial search ranking models solely for user engagement signals often introduces systematic biases, prioritizing popular or price-anchored items that may not satisfy semantic intent. We present a production-scale multi-task ranking system that integrates semantic relevance as a primary optimization objective, enabling explicit and controllable relevance-engagement trade-offs. Our architecture employs an ordinal relevance head that predicts cumulative probabilities over relevance thresholds, preserving the inherent ordering of labels. These outputs are integrated with engagement heads through a unified value model scoring function, enabling systematic balancing of semantic quality and short-term behavioral signals. To provide high-quality supervision for this multi-task framework, we utilize fine-tuned lightweight Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate three-level ordinal relevance labels: irrelevant, moderately relevant, and highly relevant. We address challenges regarding label distribution sensitivity and ensure high alignment with human annotations to enable efficient labeling for over 100 million query-item pairs. Evaluation across offline metrics, including NDCG@10, and online A/B experiments demonstrates that our approach significantly improves semantic alignment while preserving core engagement objectives.

AI.title_translation: 电子商务多任务排序中相关性与参与度的联合优化及高效LLM监督
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在电商搜索中联合优化语义相关性与用户参与度的多任务排序系统，利用微调的轻量级LLM生成高质量的序数标签进行高效监督，实现了相关性与参与度的可控平衡。
AI.motivation: 在工业级搜索排序模型中，如果仅针对用户参与度（engagement）信号进行优化，往往会引入系统性偏差，优先推荐那些热门或受价格锚定的商品，而这些商品可能并不符合用户的真实语义搜索意图。
AI.method:
1. 架构设计：采用序数相关性头部（ordinal relevance head）预测在相关性阈值上的累积概率，以保留标签的固有顺序。
2. 联合优化：通过统一的价值模型评分函数（value model scoring function）将相关性输出与参与度头部集成，系统性平衡语义质量和短期行为信号。
3. 数据监督：利用微调的轻量级大语言模型（LLMs）高效生成三级序数相关性标签（不相关、中等相关、高度相关），并解决标签分布敏感性问题，确保与人类标注高度一致。
AI.result: 在离线指标（包括NDCG@10）和在线A/B测试的评估中，该方法在保持核心用户参与度目标的同时，显著提高了搜索结果的语义对齐度。成功实现了对超过100万（摘要中提及1亿，即100 million）查询-商品对的高效标注。
AI.conclusion: 该多任务排序系统结合高效的轻量级LLM监督，成功在电子商务搜索中实现了语义相关性与用户参与度之间的系统性平衡，证明了利用LLM进行大规模工业级数据标注和模型优化的可行性。
AI.translation: 仅针对用户参与度信号优化工业搜索排序模型往往会引入系统性偏差，优先推荐热门或受价格锚定但可能无法满足语义意图的商品。我们提出了一种生产规模的多任务排序系统，该系统将语义相关性作为主要优化目标，从而实现显式且可控的相关性与参与度之间的权衡。我们的架构采用了一个序数相关性头部，该头部预测相关性阈值上的累积概率，从而保留了标签的固有顺序。这些输出通过统一的价值模型评分函数与参与度头部相结合，从而能够系统地平衡语义质量和短期行为信号。为了给该多任务框架提供高质量的监督，我们利用微调的轻量级大语言模型（LLM）来生成三级序数相关性标签：不相关、中等相关和高度相关。我们解决了关于标签分布敏感性的挑战，并确保与人工标注高度一致，从而实现了对超过1亿个查询-商品对的高效标注。在包括NDCG@10在内的离线指标以及在线A/B实验中的评估表明，我们的方法在保留核心参与度目标的同时，显著提高了语义对齐。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于电子商务的生产级多任务排序系统，旨在解决仅优化参与度导致的语义偏差。该系统通过引入序数相关性头部和统一的价值评分函数，实现了语义相关性与用户参与度之间的可控平衡。同时，研究利用微调的轻量级LLM，为超过1亿个查询-商品对高效生成了高质量的三级序数相关性标签。离线和在线实验表明，该方法在不损害核心参与度指标的前提下，显著提升了语义对齐。
AI.keywords: 多任务排序, 语义相关性, 电子商务, 大语言模型监督, 联合优化
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将轻量级LLM的高效标签生成（超过1亿规模）与多任务排序架构相结合，解决了电商搜索中“高参与度但低相关性”的经典痛点。采用序数相关性头部预测累积概率，能够较好地保留相关性级别之间的顺序关系。局限性在于对LLM生成标签的分布敏感性调优细节在摘要中未完全展开。

title: AgenticVBench: Can AI Agents Complete Real-World Post-Production Tasks?
summary: Video production workflows offer a rich and demanding arena for evaluating multimodal AI agents: they require composite capabilities across text, image, audio, and video understanding, along with long-horizon planning, and tool use. To this end, we introduce AgenticVBench, a benchmark of 100 agentic tasks across 4 task families spanning the real world post-production workflow, constructed from real production workflows contributed by 20 industry experts averaging 6 years of professional experience. Tasks are paired with evaluation specifications that combine programmatic verifiers and expert rubrics. We evaluate frontier vision-language models (VLMs) with both vendor-native and open-source harnesses. The best evaluated agent stack barely crosses 30%, far below human expert performance on the same tasks. We further find that the choice of harness substantially affects model behavior, including scores, tool-use patterns, and failure modes. AgenticVBench provides a foundation for diagnosing and improving both models and harnesses for agentic video production. Benchmark website: https://agenticvbench.com.

AI.title_translation: AgenticVBench：AI智能体能否完成真实的后期制作任务？
AI.tldr: 本文推出AgenticVBench基准，用于评估AI智能体在真实视频后期制作任务中的表现，结果显示最顶尖的智能体得分也仅勉强达到30%，远低于人类专家。
AI.motivation: 视频制作工作流需要文本、图像、音频和视频理解的综合能力，以及长程规划和工具使用，是评估多模态AI智能体的理想且极具挑战性的场景。然而，目前缺乏一个系统评估AI智能体在真实视频后期制作中表现的基准。
AI.method: 引入了AgenticVBench，这是一个包含100个智能体任务（横跨4个任务族）的基准测试，涵盖真实的后期制作工作流。这些任务由20位平均有6年专业经验的行业专家构建，并配有结合了程序化验证器和专家评分细则的评估规范。研究者使用厂商原生和开源测试框架对前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）进行了评估。
AI.result: 即使是表现最好的智能体系统，其得分也勉强超过30%，远低于人类专家在相同任务上的表现。此外，评估框架（harness）的选择会显著影响模型的行为，包括其得分、工具使用模式和失败模式。
AI.conclusion: AgenticVBench为诊断和改进用于智能视频制作的模型和评估框架奠定了坚实的基础，展示了当前AI智能体在处理复杂、长程的真实世界任务时仍面临重大挑战。
AI.translation: 视频制作工作流为评估多模态AI智能体提供了一个丰富且具有挑战性的舞台：它们需要文本、图像、音频和视频理解的综合能力，以及长程规划和工具使用。为此，我们推出了AgenticVBench，这是一个包含4个任务族、共100个智能体任务的基准，涵盖了真实的后期制作工作流，由20位平均拥有6年专业经验的行业专家贡献的真实制作流程构建而成。任务与结合了程序化验证器和专家评分细则的评估规范相匹配。我们使用厂商原生和开源框架评估了前沿的视觉语言模型（VLM）。评估结果显示，表现最好的智能体系统得分勉强超过30%，远低于人类专家在相同任务上的表现。我们还发现，评估框架的选择会显著影响模型的行为，包括得分、工具使用模式和失败模式。AgenticVBench为诊断和改进用于智能视频制作的模型和评估框架奠定了基础。基准网站：https://agenticvbench.com。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了AgenticVBench，这是一个旨在评估多模态AI智能体执行真实视频后期制作任务能力的基准测试。该基准由行业专家根据实际工作流构建，包含100个复杂的智能体任务。评估结果表明，当前最先进的视觉语言模型（VLM）在这些任务上的表现（约30%）远低于人类水平，且测试框架的选择会显著影响评估结果。该基准为未来改进视频制作智能体及评估工具提供了基础。
AI.keywords: AI智能体, 视频后期制作, 基准测试, 视觉语言模型, 多模态理解
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将AI智能体的评估场景拓展到了高度复杂的视频后期制作领域，并利用行业专家的真实工作流构建了高质量的基准测试。其局限性可能在于任务数量（100个）相对较小，且专家评估可能存在一定的主观性。该基准揭示了当前VLM智能体与人类专家之间的巨大鸿沟，对于推动多模态智能体在实际工业场景落地具有重要意义。

title: Chain-based Adaptive Reconfiguration Over Lattices for Hallucination Reduction
summary: We introduce CAROL (Chain-based Adaptive Reconfiguration Over Lattices), a probabilistic framework for test-time hallucination reduction in large language models. Rather than relying on token-level uncertainty, CAROL defines a semantic uncertainty measure based on the consistency between generated responses and a trusted context, inducing a string-submodular objective over a lattice of textual sequences. This formulation enables hallucination mitigation to be cast as a Markov chain accept-reject process with provable convergence and near-optimality guarantees, allowing the model to iteratively refine outputs toward semantic consistency. By operating at the level of meaning, CAROL unifies hallucination detection and mitigation within a single framework. Empirical results on question answering and multi-agent reasoning benchmarks show that CAROL significantly reduces hallucinations and improves reliability and interpretability compared to likelihood-based and retrieval-augmented baselines, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 基于格上链式自适应重构的幻觉缓解方法
AI.tldr: CAROL是一个在测试阶段降低LLM幻觉的概率框架，它通过将语义一致性转化为格上的马尔可夫链接受-拒绝过程，实现对生成内容的迭代细化与幻觉消除。
AI.motivation: 现有的幻觉缓解方法通常依赖于Token级别的不确定性，缺乏对语义层面一致性的把握。为了解决这一问题，需要一种在测试阶段能够基于语义不确定性、统一幻觉检测与缓解，且具有理论保证的框架。
AI.method: 提出了CAROL框架。该方法首先基于生成回复与可信上下文之间的一致性定义了语义不确定性度量，进而在文本序列格（lattice）上诱导出字符串次模目标。通过将幻觉缓解建模为马尔可夫链接受-拒绝（accept-reject）过程，模型能够以可证明的收敛性和近乎最优的保证，迭代地对输出进行重构和细化，直至达到语义一致。
AI.result: 在问答和多智能体推理基准测试上的实验结果表明，与基于似然和检索增强的基线方法相比，CAROL显著减少了幻觉，提高了模型的可靠性和可解释性，同时保持了具有竞争力的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: CAROL通过在语义层面进行操作，成功将幻觉检测与缓解统一在单个框架中，为测试时大语言模型的幻觉抑制提供了一种理论上有保证、可靠且高效的概率解决方案。
AI.translation: 我们引入了 CAROL（基于格上链式自适应重构），这是一个用于在大语言模型测试阶段减少幻觉的概率框架。CAROL 并不依赖于 token 级别的不确定性，而是基于生成的回复与可信上下文之间的一致性，定义了一种语义不确定性度量，从而在文本序列格上引入了字符串次模（string-submodular）目标。这种构建方式使幻觉缓解能够被转化为一个具有可证明收敛性和近乎最优保证的马尔可夫链接受-拒绝过程，从而允许模型迭代地将输出细化为语义一致的内容。通过在意义层面进行操作，CAROL 在单个框架内统一了幻觉检测和缓解。在问答和多智能体推理基准上的实证结果表明，与基于似然和检索增强的基线方法相比，CAROL 显著减少了幻觉，并提高了可靠性和可解释性，同时保持了具有竞争力的计算效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CAROL框架，这是一种用于在测试时减少大语言模型幻觉的概率框架。该框架不依赖Token级不确定性，而是通过度量生成回复与可信上下文的语义一致性，在文本序列格上构建字符串次模目标，并将幻觉缓解转化为具有收敛保证的马尔可夫链接受-拒绝过程。实验表明，该方法在问答和多智能体推理任务中显著降低了幻觉，提升了模型可靠性与可解释性。
AI.keywords: 幻觉缓解, 语义不确定性, 马尔可夫链, 测试时优化, 字符串次模性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将大语言模型的幻觉缓解问题转化为文本序列格上的马尔可夫链接受-拒绝过程，并引入了具有理论收敛和近优保证的字符串次模目标，实现了检测与缓解的统一。其局限性可能在于，尽管声称保持了竞争力的计算效率，但测试时的迭代马尔可夫链采样过程相比单次直接推理仍会增加计算延迟，且高度依赖于“可信上下文”的获取。

title: ReverseMath: Answer Inversion for Scalable and Verifiable Mathematical Problem Generation
summary: Mathematical reasoning benchmarks are vital for evaluating large language models (LLMs), but many are static and repeatedly exposed through public evaluation and training pipelines, making it difficult to separate genuine reasoning from memorization. Meanwhile, manually constructing new math problems with reliable answers remains costly. We introduce ReverseMath, a scalable method for generating new math problems through answer inversion. Given a problem and its answer, ReverseMath masks a numerical value in the original problem, treats the original answer as a known condition, and rewrites the problem so that the masked value becomes the new answer. The generated problem reverses the original input-output relation, making its answer known by construction. We study ReverseMath for both evaluation and training. For evaluation, paired original/reversed problems reveal substantial behavioral shifts: models sometimes fail on reversed problems and even incorrectly output the original answer, suggesting memorization-like behavior. For training, ReverseMath provides automatically labeled reversed problems as data augmentation for reinforcement learning (RL). Experiments show that including ReverseMath-generated data improves mathematical reasoning performance across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating its value as both an analysis tool and a scalable source of verifiable training data.

AI.title_translation: ReverseMath：用于可扩展且可验证数学问题生成的答案逆推法
AI.tldr: ReverseMath 通过将原数学题的数值掩码并把原答案转为已知条件，逆向生成新问题，既能有效评估大模型的记忆行为，又能作为强化学习的数据增强提升其数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的数学推理基准测试大多是静态的，容易在训练中被模型记忆，难以区分模型是真正掌握了推理能力还是单纯的死记硬背；同时，人工构建具有可靠答案的新数学问题成本极高。
AI.method: 提出 ReverseMath 方法：给定一个数学问题及其答案，该方法将原问题中的某个数值进行掩码，把原答案作为已知条件，并重新表述问题，使被掩码的数值成为新问题的答案，从而逆转输入输出关系，自动生成带有可靠标签的新问题。
AI.result: 在评估方面，配对的原始与逆向问题暴露了模型的记忆行为（模型在逆向问题上表现变差，甚至错误输出原答案）；在训练方面，将 ReverseMath 生成的逆向问题作为强化学习的数据增强，显著提升了模型在多个数学推理基准测试上的性能。
AI.conclusion: ReverseMath 是一种高效、可扩展且答案可验证的数学问题生成方法，既可以作为评估大模型记忆行为的分析工具，也可以作为提升模型数学推理能力的训练数据源。
AI.translation: 数学推理基准对于评估大语言模型（LLM）至关重要，但许多基准是静态的，且在公开评估和训练管道中反复暴露，这使得将真正的推理与记忆区分开来变得困难。同时，手动构建具有可靠答案的新数学问题仍然成本高昂。我们引入了 ReverseMath，这是一种通过答案逆推生成新数学问题的可扩展方法。给定一个问题及其答案，ReverseMath 会掩码原始问题中的一个数值，将原始答案视为已知条件，并重写该问题，使被掩码的数值成为新的答案。生成的问题逆转了原始的输入-输出关系，使其答案在构建时就是已知的。我们针对评估和训练对 ReverseMath 进行了研究。对于评估，配对的原始/逆向问题揭示了显著的行为转变：模型有时会在逆向问题上失败，甚至错误地输出原始答案，这表明存在类似记忆的行为。对于训练，ReverseMath 提供了自动标记的逆向问题，作为强化学习（RL）的数据增强。实验表明，加入 ReverseMath 生成的数据提高了多个基准测试中的数学推理性能，证明了其作为分析工具和可扩展、可验证训练数据源的价值。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 ReverseMath，这是一种通过“答案逆推”来自动生成新数学问题的方法。该方法通过掩码原问题中的数值并引入原答案作为已知条件，重写出答案已知的新问题。ReverseMath 可用于评估大模型的记忆效应，并能作为强化学习的数据增强手段，有效提升大模型的数学推理能力。
AI.keywords: 答案逆推, 数学推理, 大语言模型, 数据增强, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种非常巧妙且实用的“答案逆推”方法。其创新之处在于通过改变问题的已知和未知条件，在保证答案绝对正确的前提下，低成本地生成全新的数学问题。这不仅为缓解大模型在静态数据集上的“过拟合/死记硬背”问题提供了强有力的评估工具，还为强化学习提供了一种高质量、可扩展的自动标注数据源。局限性可能在于该方法主要适用于数值计算类题目，对于逻辑证明或非数值型数学问题的拓展能力尚待观察。

title: DeepSciVerify: Verifying Scientific Claim--Citation Alignment via LLM-Driven Evidence Escalation
summary: Misalignment between claims and their cited evidence is a common failure mode in reports generated by large language models, limiting their reliability in scientific and other high-stakes settings. We present DeepSciVerify, a two-stage pipeline for scientific claim-citation verification that combines abstract-level reasoning with selective escalation to passage-level evidence. The system first verifies claims using the abstract and defers uncertain cases, retrieving and analyzing full-text passages only when necessary. This design leverages complementary behaviors across LLMs, as some models are more conservative while others are more decisive under uncertainty. On the SCitance benchmark, DeepSciVerify achieves 86.7 Micro-F1, outperforming strong abstract-only baselines by +4.5 points while resolving 67% of instances without full-text retrieval. These results suggest that selective evidence escalation improves both accuracy and efficiency in claim-citation verification.

AI.title_translation: DeepSciVerify：通过大语言模型驱动的证据升级验证科学声称与引用的对齐
AI.tldr: DeepSciVerify通过两阶段框架（先用摘要快速验证，不确定时再升级到全文段落检索），在大幅提升科学声称-引用验证准确率的同时，减少了67%的全文检索开销。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的报告中经常出现“声称”与其“引用证据”不一致（对齐失败）的问题，这严重限制了LLM在科学及其他高风险场景中的可靠性。然而，直接对所有引用进行全文检索和分析的成本过高。
AI.method:
提出了一种名为DeepSciVerify的两阶段验证管线：
1. 第一阶段：首先利用文献摘要进行声称验证，并识别出不确定的案例；
2. 第二阶段：针对不确定的案例进行“证据升级”，仅在必要时检索并分析全文段落。
该设计充分利用了不同大语言模型在面对不确定性时的互补行为（部分模型偏向保守，部分模型偏向果断）。
AI.result: 在SCitance基准测试中，DeepSciVerify取得了86.7的Micro-F1值，比仅使用摘要的强基线方法高出4.5个百分点。同时，该方法在无需检索全文的情况下成功解决了67%的验证实例，显著提升了效率。
AI.conclusion: 选择性证据升级策略在科学声称-引用验证中能够同时提高验证的准确性和效率。
AI.translation: 大语言模型生成的报告中，声称与其引用的证据之间不一致是一个常见的失败模式，这限制了它们在科学及其他高风险场景中的可靠性。我们提出了DeepSciVerify，这是一个用于科学声称-引用验证的两阶段管线，它将摘要层面的推理与选择性升级到段落层面的证据相结合。该系统首先利用摘要验证声称，并推迟不确定案例的处理，仅在必要时检索和分析全文段落。这种设计利用了不同大语言模型（LLM）之间的互补行为，因为某些模型在面对不确定性时较为保守，而另一些模型则更为果断。在SCitance基准测试中，DeepSciVerify实现了86.7的Micro-F1值，比强劲的仅摘要基线模型高出4.5个百分点，同时在无需全文检索的情况下解决了67%的实例。这些结果表明，选择性证据升级提高了声称-引用验证的准确性和效率。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型在科学报告中常见的声称与引用不一致问题，提出了DeepSciVerify验证框架。该框架采用两阶段策略，首先通过摘要对声称进行快速验证，仅在遇到无法确定的情况时才选择性地升级检索全文段落。实验表明，该方法在SCitance基准上不仅显著提升了验证准确率，还大幅减少了全文检索的开销，实现了准确性与效率的双重提升。
AI.keywords: 声称-引用验证, 大语言模型, 证据升级, 信息检索, 科学文献分析
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种非常实用的两阶段验证框架，巧妙地在验证精度与计算效率（全文检索开销）之间取得了平衡。其核心创新点在于“选择性证据升级”策略，即先用摘要进行低成本验证，仅对不确定样本升级到全文段落验证。此外，利用不同大语言模型在面对不确定性时表现出的互补特性（保守型与果断型）来进行决策，设计十分新颖。局限性在于，该方法的效果可能高度依赖于大语言模型对自身不确定性的评估（校准能力），且摘要本身信息的局限性可能会导致部分漏判。

title: Prefix-Safe Bayesian Belief Tracking for LLM Reasoning Reliability:Separating Calibration from Ranking
summary: Long reasoning traces need reliability estimates before final answers are known. We study prefix-conditioned eventual-success estimation, $P(y=1 \mid o_{1:t})$, using prefix-safe observations. Sequential Bayesian Belief Tracking (SBBT) calibrates observation likelihoods and recursively updates a two-state belief, providing a common tracker for scalar scores, text and self-verification markers, hidden clusters, token-pooling probes, and latent-trajectory features. Across generated open-weight traces on MATH-500, GSM8K, AIME 2025, and RIMO-N, probability quality and ranking separate: score-only SBBT often improves Brier, while AUROC gains require structure-aware evidence beyond strong prefix-safe baselines. In the strongest hard math setting, structure-aware observations reach +0.110 AUROC against standard prefix-safe baselines. Under a same-prefix classifier audit, MATH-500 text markers and RIMO-N self-verification signals remain positive. Together, these findings support SBBT as a calibration-aware online inference framework and expose an evidence regime: scalar scores mainly support probability quality, while structure-aware prefix signals support ranking only when strong prefix-safe baselines have not already absorbed the rank evidence.

AI.title_translation: 前缀安全的贝叶斯信念追踪用于提升LLM推理可靠性：校准与排序的分离
AI.tldr: 提出顺序贝叶斯信念追踪（SBBT）框架，用于在LLM推理过程中实时估计成功概率，发现标量分数主要提升概率校准，而结构感知信号在特定条件下能显著改善排序性能。
AI.motivation: 在最终答案确定之前，长推理路径需要可靠的实时可靠性估计（即前缀条件下的最终成功概率）。
AI.method: 提出顺序贝叶斯信念追踪（Sequential Bayesian Belief Tracking, SBBT）框架。该方法通过校准观测似然并递归更新双状态信念，为标量分数、文本和自验证标记、隐藏聚类、Token池化探针以及潜在轨迹特征等多种前缀安全（prefix-safe）观测提供了一个统一的追踪器。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、GSM8K、AIME 2025和RIMO-N数据集上的实验表明，概率质量和排序性能出现分离：仅使用分数的SBBT通常能改善Brier分数（概率校准），而AUROC（排序）的提升需要结构感知证据。在最困难的数学设置中，结构感知观测相比标准前缀安全基线实现了+0.110的AUROC提升。此外，在同前缀分类器审计下，MATH-500文本标记和RIMO-N自验证信号依然保持正向。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了SBBT作为一种校准感知在线推理框架的有效性，并揭示了独特的证据机制：标量分数主要用于提升概率质量（校准），而结构感知前缀信号则在强前缀安全基线尚未吸收排序证据时，对提升排序性能（AUROC）至关重要。
AI.translation: 长推理路径在已知最终答案之前需要进行可靠性估计。我们研究了使用前缀安全（prefix-safe）观测的前缀条件最终成功估计 $P(y=1 \mid o_{1:t})$。顺序贝叶斯信念追踪（SBBT）校准观测似然并递归更新双状态信念，为标量分数、文本和自验证标记、隐藏聚类、Token池化探针以及潜在轨迹特征提供了一个通用的追踪器。在MATH-500、GSM8K、AIME 2025和RIMO-N上生成的开源权重路径中，概率质量和排序发生了分离：仅使用分数的SBBT通常能改善Brier分数，而AUROC的提升则需要超越强前缀安全基线的结构感知证据。在最难的数学设置中，结构感知观测相比标准前缀安全基线实现了+0.110的AUROC提升。在同前缀分类器审计下，MATH-500文本标记和RIMO-N自验证信号保持正向。总之，这些发现支持SBBT作为一种校准感知的在线推理框架，并揭示了一种证据机制：标量分数主要支持概率质量，而结构感知前缀信号只有在强前缀安全基线尚未吸收排序证据时，才支持排序。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型长推理过程中的可靠性评估问题，研究了基于前缀安全观测的最终成功概率估计。作者提出了顺序贝叶斯信念追踪（SBBT）框架，通过递归更新双状态信念来融合多种观测信号。实验表明，概率校准与排序性能在不同信号下呈现分离特征：标量分数主要有助于提升概率质量，而结构感知信号在基线未饱和时能显著提高排序性能。
AI.keywords: 顺序贝叶斯信念追踪, LLM推理可靠性, 概率校准, 排序性能, 前缀安全观测
AI.comments: 本文巧妙地将贝叶斯信念追踪引入到大语言模型推理可靠性的在线评估中，并深入探讨了“校准（Calibration）”与“排序（Ranking）”之间的分离现象。其创新之处在于提出并验证了一个统一的框架（SBBT），能够有效融合标量分数、文本标记、潜在轨迹特征等多种异构的前缀安全观测信号。其局限性在于，结构感知信号对排序性能（AUROC）的提升受限于基线的强弱，在强基线已经吸收了排序证据的情况下，其边际效应会显著减弱。

title: Beyond Input Understanding: Diagnosing Multilingual Mathematical Reasoning with Directed Acyclic Trace Graphs
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong mathematical reasoning performance in English, but remain much less reliable in many low- and medium-resource languages. This gap is often explained as a failure to understand non-English problem statements. We show that this view is incomplete: even when the problem is given in English, controlling the model's reasoning language can substantially reduce accuracy, suggesting that language also affects reasoning execution itself. To study this effect, we introduce DATG, a Directed Acyclic Trace Graph framework that maps reasoning traces to language-independent mathematical anchors and dependencies. This allows us to align target-language traces with reference DAGs and measure whether they cover required mathematical nodes, respect dependency edges, and avoid harmful mathematical actions. Experiments on the Qwen3 series across 12 languages show that non-English reasoning often suffers from reduced anchor coverage and weaker dependency fidelity, especially in low-resource languages. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Loop-Retry and Formula-Retry, two simple test-time controls targeting DATG-exposed failure modes, and show that they consistently improve target-language reasoning performance in low-resource languages.

AI.title_translation: 超越输入理解：利用有向无环跟踪图诊断多语言数学推理
AI.tldr: 本文提出了DATG框架，将推理轨迹映射为语言无关的有向无环图，用以诊断大模型在多语言数学推理中的执行缺陷，并据此设计了两种测试时控制方法，显著提升了低资源语言的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在非英语（尤其是中低资源语言）中的数学推理性能较差。传统观点将此归咎于模型无法理解非英语的问题输入，但本文发现，即使输入为英文，强制模型使用非英文进行推理也会导致准确率下降。因此，需要一种方法来诊断和分析语言如何影响推理的具体执行过程。
AI.method: 引入了有向无环跟踪图（DATG）框架，将推理轨迹映射到与语言无关的数学锚点和依赖关系上，通过将目标语言的推理轨迹与标准DAG进行对齐，评估其节点覆盖度、依赖边遵守情况及有害行为。此外，基于诊断出的失效模式，提出了Loop-Retry和Formula-Retry两种简单的测试时控制方法。
AI.result: 在Qwen3系列模型上跨12种语言的实验表明，非英语推理（尤其是低资源语言）普遍存在数学锚点覆盖率低和依赖保真度弱的问题。应用Loop-Retry和Formula-Retry这两种测试时控制方法后，低资源语言的目标语言推理性能得到了持续且显著的提升。
AI.conclusion: 语言不仅会影响模型对输入问题的理解，还会显著干扰数学推理的执行过程。通过DATG框架可以有效诊断并量化这种执行层面的缺陷，而采用简单的测试时控制策略（如Loop-Retry和Formula-Retry）能有效缓解这些问题，显著提升低资源语言下的推理表现。
AI.translation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在英语中展现出强大的数学推理性能，但在许多低资源和中等资源语言中表现却不尽如人意。这种差距通常被解释为模型无法理解非英语的问题陈述。我们表明这种观点是不完整的：即使问题是以英语给出的，控制模型的推理语言也会大幅降低其准确性，这表明语言本身也会影响推理过程的执行。为了研究这种影响，我们引入了DATG（有向无环跟踪图）框架，该框架将推理轨迹映射到与语言无关的数学锚点和依赖关系上。这使我们能够将目标语言的推理轨迹与参考DAG进行对齐，并衡量它们是否覆盖了所需的数学节点、是否遵守了依赖边以及是否避免了有害的数学行为。在Qwen3系列模型上针对12种语言进行的实验表明，非英语推理通常面临锚点覆盖率降低和依赖保真度变弱的问题，尤其是在低资源语言中。在这一诊断结果的启发下，我们提出了Loop-Retry（循环重试）和Formula-Retry（公式重试），这是两种针对DATG所暴露失效模式的简单测试时控制方法，并证明它们能够持续提高低资源语言中的目标语言推理性能。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了语言对大型推理模型（LRM）数学推理执行过程的影响。作者提出了DATG框架，通过将推理轨迹转化为有向无环图，诊断多语言推理中的结构性缺陷。实验表明，非英语推理（特别是低资源语言）常伴随关键数学节点的缺失和逻辑依赖的断裂。为此，本文提出了两种测试时控制策略，有效改善了低资源语言的数学推理性能。
AI.keywords: 多语言数学推理, 有向无环跟踪图 (DATG), 大型推理模型, 诊断分析, 测试时控制
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于打破了“多语言数学推理能力差主要源于输入理解障碍”的传统认知，指出推理所使用的语言本身会严重影响推理执行的逻辑完整性。提出DATG框架，将具象的文本推理轨迹抽象为语言无关的有向无环图，为大模型推理过程的精细化、结构化诊断提供了新颖的工具。不过，该方法可能依赖于高质量参考DAG的构建，且提出的重试机制（Retry）在实际应用中会带来额外的计算推理开销。

title: LLM Based Web Accessibility Repair: An Empirical Study of Detection, Remediation, and Cost
summary: Ensuring web accessibility at scale remains challenging because rule-based tools provide limited coverage while manual remediation is costly and error-prone. This paper evaluates large language model based agents, specifically Kimi K2.5, for automated accessibility detection and repair compared with rule-based approaches. For detection, the LLM achieves performance comparable to rule-based tools, with F1 around 0.65, strong semantic understanding with F1 of 0.83, but lower reliability for syntactic and layout-related violations. For remediation, LLM-generated fixes are syntactically valid in over 99.7 percent of cases and improve accessibility compliance in 80.2 percent of instances, reducing violations from 3.98 to 1.7 per file. However, fewer than 26 percent of cases are fully resolved, and about 30 percent of patches introduce structural changes. We also find that iterative agent-based refinement increases computational cost by 52 percent and API usage by 1.64 times without improving remediation outcomes. These findings indicate that while LLMs are effective for partial accessibility repair, they are insufficient for complete and reliable remediation. Scalable accessibility solutions require hybrid approaches that combine LLM capabilities with rule-based validation and constraint-aware correction mechanisms.

AI.title_translation: 基于大语言模型的网页无障碍修复：关于检测、修复和成本的实证研究
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了LLM（如Kimi K2.5）在网页无障碍检测与修复中的表现，发现其在语义理解和部分修复上效果显著，但完全修复率低（不足26%）且迭代优化成本高昂，因此未来需要结合规则验证的混合修复方案。
AI.motivation: 在大规模场景下确保网页无障碍性一直是个难题：传统的基于规则的工具覆盖范围有限，而人工修复不仅成本高昂，而且容易出错。因此，需要探索大语言模型在自动化网页无障碍检测与修复中的可行性及成本。
AI.method: 通过使用基于大语言模型的智能体（具体为Kimi K2.5），在网页无障碍检测和修复任务中进行实验，并将其与传统的基于规则的方法进行对比。此外，还评估了基于智能体的迭代式优化方法在修复效果和计算成本（API使用量等）上的表现。
AI.result:
1. 检测方面：LLM总体表现与规则工具相当（F1约0.65），在语义理解上表现强劲（F1达0.83），但对语法和布局相关违规的检测可靠性较低。
2. 修复方面：LLM生成的修复代码在99.7%以上的案例中语法有效，在80.2%的实例中提升了无障碍合规性，将每个文件的违规数从3.98降至1.7；但完全解决的比例低于26%，且约30%的补丁引入了结构性变化。
3. 成本方面：基于智能体的迭代优化使计算成本增加了52%，API使用量增加了1.64倍，但并未提升修复效果。
AI.conclusion: LLM虽然能有效进行部分网页无障碍修复，但无法提供完全和可靠的修复。要实现可扩展且可靠的网页无障碍解决方案，必须采用将LLM能力与基于规则的验证、约束感知纠正机制相结合的混合方法。
AI.translation: 在大规模范围内确保网页无障碍性仍然具有挑战性，因为基于规则的工具提供的覆盖范围有限，而手动修复既昂贵又容易出错。本文评估了基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体（具体为 Kimi K2.5）在自动化无障碍检测和修复中与基于规则方法的对比表现。在检测方面，LLM 取得了与基于规则的工具相当的性能，F1 分数约为 0.65，具有强大的语义理解能力（F1 分数为 0.83），但对于语法和布局相关的违规行为可靠性较低。在修复方面，LLM 生成的修复在超过 99.7% 的案例中在语法上是有效的，并在 80.2% 的实例中提高了无障碍合规性，将每个文件的违规行为从 3.98 个减少到 1.7 个。然而，只有不到 26% 的案例得到了完全解决，并且大约 30% 的补丁引入了结构性变化。我们还发现，基于智能体的迭代改进使计算成本增加了 52%，API 使用量增加了 1.64 倍，但并没有改善修复效果。这些发现表明，虽然 LLM 对于部分无障碍修复是有效的，但它们不足以进行完整且可靠的修复。可扩展的无障碍解决方案需要采用混合方法，将 LLM 的能力与基于规则的验证以及约束感知纠正机制相结合。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于大语言模型（LLM）的网页无障碍检测与修复进行了实证研究。通过对Kimi K2.5智能体的评估发现，LLM在语义理解和部分无障碍修复上表现优异，能显著减少代码中的无障碍违规，但其完全修复率较低（不足26%），且容易在修复时引入结构性变化。此外，迭代式智能体优化会大幅增加计算和API成本，却无法改善修复质量。研究表明，未来高效的无障碍解决方案应结合LLM与规则验证的混合方法。
AI.keywords: 网页无障碍, 大语言模型, 自动化修复, 实证研究, 成本评估
AI.comments:
创新点：本文对大模型（特别是Kimi K2.5）在网页无障碍（Web Accessibility）检测、修复以及实际计算成本方面进行了系统性的实证评估，填补了该领域定量分析的空白。
重要性：研究指出了LLM在处理复杂布局和语法约束时的局限性，并量化了智能体迭代优化带来的高昂成本（计算成本增加52%），这对于工业界开发高性价比的自动化无障碍修复工具具有重要指导意义。
局限性：本研究主要基于Kimi K2.5模型，其结论在其他主流大模型（如GPT-4、Claude等）上的泛化性还有待进一步对比验证。

title: Characterizing the Configuration of Starlink Queuing
comments: This is an author-supplied definitive version of a paper accepted at IMC'26 cycle 1 on 2nd Feb 2026. First submitted to IMC'25 in 15th May 2025 and accepted with one-shot-revision on 15th Aug 2025. Please cite with ACM reference format once the ACM DOI is active. 10 pages, 7 figures
summary: In all networking systems, queuing is important to ensure appropriate resource utilization in the presence of bursty traffic and varying traffic demands. The Starlink access network is additionally also dynamic in terms of the capacity it can provide, and thus queuing plays an even greater role to ensure appropriate communication performance for the end-users while maintaining high resource utilization. However, for Starlink most system design details, along with the setup of the internal queuing, is private information and not publicly available. To address this we have developed a high-precision, burst-pattern controlled, traffic generation approach allowing us to precisely measure the one-way delay for Starlink. By analyzing the delay and loss in conjunction with a queue simulator we find that Starlink does not employ per-flow fair queuing or drop-tail buffers, but it does use drop-front buffer management. While drop-front reduces delay, it may also interfere with the assumptions made by loss-based congestion controls, potentially contributing to throughput degradation.
comment: This is an author-supplied definitive version of a paper accepted at IMC'26 cycle 1 on 2nd Feb 2026. First submitted to IMC'25 in 15th May 2025 and accepted with one-shot-revision on 15th Aug 2025. Please cite with ACM reference format once the ACM DOI is active. 10 pages, 7 figures

AI.tldr: 本文通过高精度流量测量和模拟分析，发现Starlink未采用每流公平队列或尾部丢弃，而是使用了头部丢弃（drop-front）缓冲区管理，这在降低延迟的同时可能会导致吞吐量下降。
AI.motivation: 在Starlink动态变化的接入网络中，队列管理对保障性能和资源利用率至关重要，但Starlink的大多数系统设计细节和内部队列设置属于私有信息，外界无法直接获取。
AI.method: 开发了一种高精度、突发模式可控的流量生成方法，用于精确测量Starlink的单向延迟，并结合队列模拟器来分析延迟和丢包特征。
AI.result: 发现Starlink并没有采用每流公平队列（per-flow fair queuing）或尾部丢弃（drop-tail）缓存，而是使用了头部丢弃（drop-front）缓冲区管理。
AI.conclusion: 虽然Starlink采用的头部丢弃（drop-front）缓冲区管理能够减少延迟，但它也可能会干扰基于丢包的拥塞控制算法的假设，从而可能导致吞吐量下降。
AI.translation: 在所有网络系统中，队列对于在存在突发流量和变化流量需求的情况下确保适当的资源利用率至关重要。Starlink接入网络在可提供容量方面也具有动态性，因此队列在确保最终用户的适当通信性能并保持高资源利用率方面发挥着更大的作用。然而，对于Starlink来说，大多数系统设计细节以及内部队列的设置都是私有信息，无法公开获取。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种高精度、突发模式可控的流量生成方法，使我们能够精确测量Starlink的单向延迟。通过结合队列模拟器分析延迟和丢包，我们发现Starlink并没有采用每流公平队列或尾部丢弃缓存，而是使用了头部丢弃缓冲区管理。虽然头部丢弃减少了延迟，但它也可能干扰基于丢包的拥塞控制所做出的假设，从而可能导致吞吐量下降。
AI.summary: 由于Starlink的内部队列配置属于非公开信息，本文开发了一种高精度的流量生成方法来精确测量其单向延迟。通过结合队列模拟器分析延迟和丢包，研究发现Starlink采用了头部丢弃（drop-front）缓冲区管理，而非每流公平队列或尾部丢弃。这种设计虽然降低了延迟，但可能会对基于丢包的拥塞控制机制产生干扰，导致吞吐量下降。
AI.keywords: Starlink, 队列管理, 头部丢弃 (Drop-front), 单向延迟, 拥塞控制
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于通过设计一种高精度、可控突发模式的黑盒流量生成方法，成功推断出非公开的Starlink内部队列管理机制。这一发现非常重要，因为它揭示了Starlink采用的头部丢弃（drop-front）策略虽然能降低延迟，但可能与传统的基于丢包的拥塞控制协议产生冲突并导致吞吐量下降。局限性在于，该研究主要基于外部测量和模拟器推导，可能无法完全捕获Starlink所有复杂的动态排队细节。

title: Bayesian Deployment Approval for Learned Landing Controllers under Finite Rollout Validation
summary: Reinforcement learning and data-driven autonomous controllers are commonly evaluated using cumulative reward and empirical success frequency under finite simulation trajectories. However, such empirical metrics do not necessarily provide sufficient statistical evidence regarding deployment readiness under uncertainty.
