AI.summary: 本文系统地探讨了在生成器偏移（即生成器未知）的情况下，如何检测由扩散模型生成的时间序列。研究对比了基于重建的白盒检测和基于原始信号的黑盒分类检测，发现由于时间序列缺乏类似于图像的通用重建先验，白盒方法在生成器偏移时会失效，而简单的黑盒分类器则表现出奇地好。这表明时间序列的生成检测不能直接套用图像领域的经验。
AI.keywords: 时间序列检测, 扩散模型, 生成器偏移, 白盒检测, 黑盒检测
AI.comments: 本文填补了扩散生成时间序列检测领域的空白，具有很强的开创性。其核心价值在于指出：由于缺乏类似图像领域的“通用重建先验”，直接套用图像领域的白盒重建检测方法在时间序列的生成器偏移场景下会失效。这一发现对于未来跨模态生成内容检测技术的发展具有重要的警示和指导意义。局限性在于目前主要对比了较为基础的白盒与黑盒分类器，更先进的专门针对时间序列频域或时域特征的检测算法仍有待开发。

title: Score Based Error Correcting Code Decoder
summary: Error-correcting codes enable reliable communication, yet practical soft decoding remains challenging across code families and block lengths. We propose SB-ECC, a score-based decoder that casts decoding as continuous-time denoising. A neural denoiser defines a probability-flow ordinary differential equation (ODE) that iteratively updates the noisy channel observation toward a valid codeword, guided by parity constraints. The model is trained across noise levels without time/SNR conditioning, enabling inference without SNR estimation and supporting a direct latency accuracy trade off controlled by the ODE solver budget. We use the raw signed channel observation as input for learning a continuous denoising field. Across 42 code/SNR settings, SB-ECC achieves the best BER in 39/42 entries, with an average SNR gain of 0.17dB and a maximum gain of 0.46dB over the strongest competing baseline, we showed that swapping the solver from Euler to DPM preserves -ln(BER) while reducing end-to-end decoding time by 8.86% on average (up to 12.82%).

AI.title_translation: 基于得分的纠错码译码器
AI.tldr: 本文提出SB-ECC，一种将纠错码译码建模为连续时间去噪的得分匹配译码器，无需信噪比估计即可实现高精度软译码，且支持延迟与精度的灵活权衡。
AI.motivation: 尽管纠错码能保障可靠通信，但在不同的码族和块长度上，实现高效且实用的软译码（soft decoding）仍然是一个具有挑战性的难题。
AI.method: 提出SB-ECC译码器，将译码建模为连续时间去噪过程。该方法利用神经去噪器定义概率流常微分方程（ODE），在奇偶校验约束的引导下，通过迭代更新将含噪信道观测值恢复为有效码字。模型在多种噪声水平下进行训练，无需时间和SNR条件调节，支持在推理时无需SNR估计，并使用原始带符号信道观测值作为输入。
AI.result: 在42种编码/SNR设置中，SB-ECC在39个设置中取得了最佳的误码率（BER），相比最强的基线方法，平均获得0.17dB的SNR增益，最大增益达0.46dB。此外，将ODE求解器从Euler更换为DPM，可在保持误码率性能的同时，将端到端译码时间平均缩短8.86%（最高可达12.82%）。
AI.conclusion: SB-ECC作为一种基于得分的连续时间去噪译码器，不仅在多种编码和信噪比设置下刷新了误码率性能，还证明了通过更换更高效的ODE求解器（如DPM）可以在不损失精度的情况下显著降低译码延迟，为实用化软译码提供了一种新颖且高效的方案。
AI.translation: 纠错码能够实现可靠的通信，然而在不同的码族和块长度上，实际的软译码仍然面临挑战。我们提出了SB-ECC，这是一种基于得分的译码器，它将译码过程建模为连续时间去噪。神经去噪器定义了一个概率流常微分方程（ODE），在奇偶校验约束的引导下，将含有噪声的信道观测值迭代更新为有效的码字。该模型在不同的噪声水平下进行训练，无需时间或信噪比（SNR）条件调节，从而在推理时无需进行SNR估计，并支持通过ODE求解器预算来直接权衡延迟与准确性。我们使用原始带符号的信道观测值作为输入来学习连续的去噪场。在42种编码/SNR设置中，SB-ECC在39个项目中取得了最佳的误码率（BER），相比于最强的竞争基线，平均SNR增益达0.17dB，最大增益达0.46dB。我们还表明，将求解器从Euler更换为DPM可以在保持-ln(BER)的同时，将端到端译码时间平均减少8.86%（最高可达12.82%）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SB-ECC的基于得分的纠错码译码器。该方法将软译码过程视为连续时间去噪，通过神经网络定义的概率流常微分方程（ODE）并在奇偶校验约束引导下进行迭代译码。该模型无需信噪比（SNR）估计即可推理，并允许通过调整求解器预算来平衡延迟与精度。实验表明其在多种编码设置下均达到了最先进的误码率性能。
AI.keywords: 纠错码, 软译码, 基于得分的模型, 概率流ODE, 神经网络去噪
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将生成式扩散模型中的得分匹配（Score-based）和概率流ODE引入到纠错码译码领域，打破了传统译码算法的局限。其无需信噪比（SNR）先验信息的特性极具实用价值。然而，作为基于神经网络和ODE迭代求解的译码器，其在超低延迟和高吞吐量的实际硬件部署中可能仍面临计算复杂度的挑战。

title: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents on Stock Markets
summary:
Evaluating whether large language model (LLM) agents can profit in capital markets is increasingly framed as end-to-end trading: place an agent in a historical market, let it trade, and measure portfolio returns. This setup is vulnerable to two evaluation failures. First, long backtests often overlap with the knowledge cutoffs of frontier LLMs, allowing memorized tickers, dates, prices, and market narratives to substitute for investment reasoning. Second, raw returns are a noisy proxy for stock-selection ability, since positive performance may come from market beta, style exposure, or favorable regimes rather than genuine alpha.
  We introduce KTD-Fin (Knowing-To-Doing Financial Benchmark), an end-to-end stock-market trading benchmark that addresses both issues. KTD-Fin uses a data-side masking protocol to anonymize key identifiers and calendar information consistently across prompts and tools, separating historical market memory from investment decision-making. It also incorporates a Barra-style performance attribution framework that decomposes portfolio returns into market, style, and stock-selection alpha components.
  Across ten frontier LLM agents evaluated on the Chinese CSI300 over a 2024--2026 window, masking substantially changes agent rationales, pushing them towards anonymized factor-based reasoning. Attribution analysis further shows that LLM agents' cumulative returns under leakage-controlled evaluation are largely explained by passive market and style exposure, with limited evidence of persistent stock-selection alpha. These findings suggest that financial LLM benchmarks should evaluate not only whether an agent makes money, but also whether the source of returns reflects transferable investment skill. We release KTD-Fin as a reproducible template for leakage-controlled and attribution-aware evaluation of LLM trading agents.

AI.title_translation: 从知到行：一种针对股票市场LLM交易智能体的记忆控制基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了KTD-Fin基准，通过数据屏蔽和业绩归因解决了LLM交易智能体评估中的数据泄露（记忆）和超额收益来源不明确的问题。
AI.motivation: 评估LLM交易智能体时存在两个主要缺陷：一是回测区间与LLM的知识截止日期重叠，导致智能体利用记忆（股票代码、价格、历史事件）而非真正的投资推理进行决策；二是原始收益率无法准确反映选股能力，因为盈利可能仅来自市场贝塔或风格敞口，而非真正的超额收益（阿尔法）。
AI.method: 提出了KTD-Fin（Knowing-To-Doing Financial Benchmark）端到端股票交易基准。其核心方法包括：1) 数据端屏蔽协议：在提示词和工具中一致地对关键标识符和日历信息进行匿名化，从而将历史市场记忆与投资决策分离开来；2) Barra风格的业绩归因框架：将投资组合收益分解为市场、风格和选股阿尔法（alpha）成分。
AI.result: 在沪深300（2024-2026年窗口期）上对10个前沿LLM智能体进行评估，结果表明：屏蔽处理显著改变了智能体的推理逻辑，使其转向匿名的基于因子的推理；在控制泄露的评估下，LLM智能体的累积收益很大程度上由被动的市场和风格敞口解释，几乎没有证据表明其具有持续的选股阿尔法。
AI.conclusion: 金融LLM基准不仅应该评估智能体是否赚钱，还应该评估其收益来源是否反映了可迁移的投资技能。KTD-Fin为泄漏控制和归因感知的LLM交易智能体评估提供了一个可复制的模板。
AI.translation:
评估大型语言模型（LLM）智能体是否能在资本市场中获利，目前越来越多地被构建为端到端交易的形式：将智能体置于历史市场中，让其进行交易，并衡量其投资组合的收益。这种设置容易受到两种评估失效的影响。首先，长期的回测通常与前沿LLM的知识截止日期重叠，使得被记忆的股票代码、日期、价格和市场叙事替代了投资推理。其次，原始收益率是选股能力的嘈杂代理指标，因为正向的业绩可能来自于市场贝塔、风格敞口或有利的市场环境，而非真正的阿尔法。

我们引入了KTD-Fin（“从知到行”金融基准），这是一个解决这两个问题的端到端股市交易基准。KTD-Fin使用数据端屏蔽协议，在提示词和工具中一致地对关键标识符和日历信息进行匿名化，从而将历史市场记忆与投资决策分离开来。它还结合了Barra风格的业绩归因框架，将投资组合收益分解为市场、风格和选股阿尔法成分。

在2024-2026年窗口期内，对在沪深300指数上评估的10个前沿LLM智能体进行测试，屏蔽显著改变了智能体的推理逻辑，推动它们转向匿名的基于因子的推理。归因分析进一步表明，在控制泄露的评估下，LLM智能体的累积收益很大程度上由被动的市场和风格敞口解释，而持续选股阿尔法的证据有限。这些发现表明，金融LLM基准不仅应该评估智能体是否赚钱，还应该评估其收益来源是否反映了可迁移的投资技能。我们发布了KTD-Fin，作为一个用于LLM交易智能体泄漏控制和归因分析评估的可复制模板。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）交易智能体评估中容易出现的“历史记忆泄露”和“原始收益无法真实反映选股能力”两个关键痛点，提出了KTD-Fin评估基准。该基准通过数据端屏蔽协议消除敏感信息以阻断记忆，并采用Barra业绩归因框架来剖析收益来源。实验表明，在控制泄露后，现有前沿LLM智能体的收益多来源于被动的市场和风格暴露，缺乏持久的选股alpha能力。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 股票交易基准, 记忆控制, 业绩归因, KTD-Fin
AI.comments: 该论文极具现实意义，直击当前LLM在金融量化投资领域评估不客观的痛点。通过匿名化（数据屏蔽）来防止LLM利用记忆“作弊”，并引入经典的Barra归因来剥离贝塔和风格，使得对LLM交易能力的评估更加严谨、科学。其局限性可能在于，过度的数据屏蔽可能会破坏LLM原本可以利用的宏观常识或特定行业背景知识。

title: Prompt Codebooks: Discrete Compositional Optimization for Language Model Instruction Refinement
summary: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has driven significant gains in LLM-based agentic workflows. However, existing methods treat each task's prompt as a monolithic, instance-blind string optimized through global edits, producing brittle updates and preventing the reuse of learned sub-behaviors. We propose Prompt Codebooks (PCO), a novel compositional prompt optimization framework that recasts APO as discrete learning over a finite vocabulary of natural-language instincts - atomic, reusable instruction units. PCO organizes prompt-construction knowledge in a discrete codebook and routes each input to a small subset of entries via an LLM-based encoder; a generator composes them into a prompt for the frozen target model; a critic emits a structured verdict that decomposes by attribution into per-variable textual gradients, jointly training the encoder, generator, and codebook under a language-valued min-max objective. The resulting routing is per-instance: different inputs in the same task receive different instinct compositions, a regime structurally inexpressible under instance-blind methods. Across six benchmarks on Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B, PCO improves over zero-shot by up to +30.36 points, surpasses the strongest prior baseline (GEPA) by +3.34 on HotpotQA and +1.11 in aggregate, and reduces deployed prompt length by up to 14.1x versus MIPROv2 and 3.0x versus GEPA using only K=16 instincts.

AI.title_translation: 提示词密码本：用于语言模型指令优化的离散组合优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prompt Codebooks (PCO)，通过将提示词优化重构为在有限“本能”词汇表上的离散学习，实现了针对不同输入的个性化、组合式提示词优化，大幅提升了LLM性能并显著缩短了提示词长度。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动提示词优化（APO）方法将每个任务的提示词视为整体的、与具体实例无关的字符串，并通过全局编辑进行优化，这导致更新脆弱且无法重用已学到的子行为。
AI.method: 提出提示词密码本（Prompt Codebooks, PCO）框架，将APO重构为在有限的自然语言“本能”（原子级、可重用的指令单元）词汇表上的离散学习。PCO在离散密码本中组织提示词构建知识，通过基于LLM的编码器将每个输入路由到一小部分条目；生成器将它们组合成针对冻结目标模型的提示词；评论器输出结构化判定，通过归因分解为每个变量的文本梯度，在语言值极小极大（min-max）目标下联合训练编码器、生成器和密码本。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和LLaMA-3.1-8B的六个基准测试中，PCO比零样本提升高达+30.36分，在HotpotQA上超越最强先前基线（GEPA）+3.34分，综合表现超越+1.11分。此外，在使用仅K=16个本能时，部署的提示词长度比MIPROv2缩短高达14.1倍，比GEPA缩短3.0倍。
AI.conclusion: PCO通过实现实例级别的提示词路由（即同一任务的不同输入获得不同的本能组合），成功克服了传统实例无关方法的结构性限制，在提高LLM提示词优化性能的同时显著降低了部署提示词的长度。
AI.translation: 自动提示词优化（APO）在基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体工作流中带来了显著的性能提升。然而，现有方法将每个任务的提示词视为一个整体的、与实例无关的字符串，并通过全局编辑进行优化，从而导致更新脆弱，且无法重用已学到的子行为。我们提出了提示词密码本（PCO），这是一种新型的组合式提示词优化框架，它将APO重构为在自然语言“本能”（即原子的、可重用的指令单元）的有限词汇表上进行的离散学习。PCO在离散密码本中组织提示词构建知识，并通过基于LLM的编码器将每个输入路由到这些条目的一个小子集；生成器将它们组合成针对冻结目标模型的提示词；评论器发出结构化的判定，该判定通过归因分解为每个变量的文本梯度，从而在语言值极小极大目标下联合训练编码器、生成器和密码本。由此产生的路由是针对每个实例的：同一任务中的不同输入会接收到不同的本能组合，这在与实例无关的方法中是结构上无法实现的。在Qwen3-8B和LLaMA-3.1-8B的六个基准测试中，PCO比零样本提升了高达+30.36分，在HotpotQA上超越了最强的前期基线（GEPA）+3.34分，在总体上超越了+1.11分，并且在仅使用K=16个本能的情况下，部署的提示词长度比MIPROv2减少了高达14.1倍，比GEPA减少了3.0倍。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有自动提示词优化方法将提示词视为单一、实例无关字符串的局限性，提出了一种名为Prompt Codebooks (PCO)的组合式提示词优化方法。PCO通过离散密码本管理自然语言“本能”（原子指令单元），利用编码器、生成器和评论器进行联合训练，实现了实例级别的提示词动态组合。实验表明，PCO在多个基准上显著超越了现有方法，并在大幅缩短提示词长度的同时提升了模型表现。
AI.keywords: 自动提示词优化, 离散组合优化, 提示词密码本, 实例级别路由, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将离散表示学习（类似于VQ-VAE中的Codebook概念）引入到自然语言提示词优化中，将复杂的提示词拆解为可重用的“本能”单元，并实现了实例级别的动态组合路由。这不仅解决了传统提示词优化方法泛化性差、冗长且难以重用的问题，还显著降低了部署时的提示词长度（最高达14.1倍），具有极高的实用和研究价值。其局限性可能在于联合训练编码器、生成器和密码本的计算开销较大，且对评论器（Critic）生成高质量文本梯度的能力有较强依赖。

title: Accelerating Robot Path Planning via Connectivity-Preserving Region Proposal Network
summary: Mobile robot path planning methods are often constrained by vast search spaces, resulting in latency in samplingbased algorithms. Learning-based approaches frequently suffer from local region fragmentation and global topological inconsistency. To tackle the problem, we present the Connectivity- Preserving Region Proposal Network (CP-RPN), a segmentationguided model designed to predict compact and topologically connected candidate regions, significantly compressing the search space. Specifically, we design a segmentation model that leverages a Deformable Attention Transformer (DAT) to capture long-range dependencies for global connectivity, with a Deconvolutional decoder to preserve fine-grained spatial details. To guarantee the connectivity of the predicted mask, we design a composite loss function that combines Cross-Entropy loss for pixelwise supervision, a Connectivity-Aware loss to enhance local coherence, and a Topological Continuity loss based on persistent homology to enforce global connectivity. Building on these highconnectivity corridor-like regions, the Voronoi diagram is used to plan the path, backed by a local A* fallback mechanism to ensure robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that CPRPN reduces the candidate region size by over 60.13% compared to the MPT baseline and achieves deterministic low-latency planning (avg. 0.11s) with a 99.60% success rate, outperforming traditional sampling-based algorithms in stability.

AI.title_translation: 通过保持连通性的区域建议网络加速机器人路径规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出CP-RPN网络，通过预测紧凑且拓扑连通的区域来压缩搜索空间，实现了平均0.11秒、成功率99.6%的高效机器人路径规划。
AI.motivation: 传统的移动机器人路径规划方法由于搜索空间庞大，导致基于采样的算法存在高延迟；而现有的基于学习的方法则容易出现局部区域碎片化和全局拓扑不一致的问题。
AI.method:
提出保持连通性的区域建议网络（CP-RPN）：
1. 分割模型：利用可变形注意力Transformer（DAT）捕捉长程依赖以保证全局连通性，并配合反卷积解码器保留细粒度空间细节。
2. 复合损失函数：结合用于像素级监督的交叉熵损失、增强局部相干性的连通性感知损失，以及基于持续同调的拓扑连续性损失。
3. 路径生成：在预测的走廊状区域上利用Voronoi图规划路径，并辅以局部A*回退机制以确保鲁棒性。
AI.result: 与MPT基线方法相比，CP-RPN将候选区域大小减少了60.13%以上，实现了平均0.11秒的确定性低延迟规划，成功率高达99.60%，在稳定性上超越了传统的基于采样的算法。
AI.conclusion: CP-RPN通过结合深度学习的区域预测能力与传统几何/搜索算法（Voronoi图与A*），成功实现了高效、低延迟且高成功率的机器人路径规划，为克服传统采样算法的延迟问题和学习算法的拓扑不一致问题提供了一种可行的解决方案。
AI.translation: 移动机器人路径规划方法通常受限于庞大的搜索空间，导致基于采样的算法存在延迟。基于学习的方法也经常面临局部区域碎片化和全局拓扑不一致的问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了保持连通性的区域建议网络（CP-RPN），这是一种分割引导的模型，旨在预测紧凑且拓扑连通的候选区域，从而显著压缩搜索空间。具体而言，我们设计了一个分割模型，该模型利用可变形注意力Transformer（DAT）来捕捉长程依赖关系以实现全局连通性，并使用反卷积解码器来保留细粒度的空间细节。为了保证预测掩码的连通性，我们设计了一个复合损失函数，该函数结合了用于像素级监督的交叉熵损失、用于增强局部相干性的连通性感知损失，以及基于持续同调的拓扑连续性损失以强制实现全局连通性。在这些高连通性的走廊状区域的基础上，利用Voronoi图进行路径规划，并辅以局部A*回退机制以确保鲁棒性。实验结果表明，与MPT基线相比，CP-RPN将候选区域大小减少了60.13%以上，并实现了确定性的低延迟规划（平均0.11秒），成功率达到99.60%，在稳定性上超越了传统的基于采样的算法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CP-RPN的保持连通性的区域建议网络，旨在加速移动机器人的路径规划。该方法通过可变形注意力Transformer和包含拓扑连续性损失的复合损失函数，预测出紧凑且全局连通的候选区域，从而大幅压缩搜索空间。最后，结合Voronoi图和局部A*回退机制进行路径生成。实验表明，该方法在显著减小搜索空间的同时，实现了极低的规划延迟和极高的成功率。
AI.keywords: 路径规划, 区域建议网络, 连通性保持, 持续同调, 机器人导航
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：将代数拓扑中的持续同调（persistent homology）引入损失函数中，设计了拓扑连续性损失，有效解决了学习型路径规划方法中常见的局部碎片化和全局不一致问题。
2. 实用性：通过预测紧凑的候选区域，将搜索空间压缩了60%以上，实现了平均0.11秒的极低延迟，对于高实时性要求的移动机器人极具应用价值。
3. 局限性：摘要中主要展示了在2D或走廊状环境下的效果，未提及该方法在高度复杂的三维空间或动态障碍物环境中的泛化能力。

title: PubMedCausal: A Span-Level Annotated Corpus for Causal Relation Extraction in Biomedical Text
comments: Submitted to EMNLP 2026, 8 Pages, 23 page appendix
summary: Causal relation extraction (CRE) is central to biomedical text mining, but current resources often conflate causal relations with broader associations, restrict annotation to sentence-level examples, or focus mainly on explicit causal cues. This limits their usefulness for evaluating whether models can recover causal claims as they are actually expressed in biomedical text. We introduce PubMedCausal, a span-level annotated corpus for biomedical CRE built from PubMed abstracts. The corpus contains 30,000 paragraph-level rows, including 3,945 causal rows and 6,491 adjudicated cause--effect pairs. Each causal relation is annotated with full-text cause and effect spans, causality type, and sententiality, enabling evaluation of both causal detection and full-span causal extraction. We benchmark discriminative encoders and open-source generative models across detection and extraction settings. For causal detection, biomedical encoders are strongest, with PubMedBERT reaching an F$_1$ score of 0.7391. For span-level extraction, the best generative baseline is DeepSeek-R1-32B with few-shot prompting, reaching a Cosine Pair F$_1$ of 0.6765. We further test transfer learning by evaluating PubMedCausal-trained encoders on external causal relation datasets, showing that the resource supports cross-dataset evaluation. Our results show that biomedical CRE remains difficult under class imbalance, long causal spans, implicit causality, inter-sentential relations, and prompt sensitivity. Code and Data can be found here: https://github.com/josiahpaul07/PubMedCausal_Exp
comment: Submitted to EMNLP 2026, 8 Pages, 23 page appendix

AI.title_translation: PubMedCausal：用于生物医学文本中因果关系提取的跨度级标注语料库
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 PubMedCausal，这是一个用于生物医学因果关系提取的段落级、跨度级标注语料库，并对判别式编码器和生成式大模型进行了全面的基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有的生物医学因果关系提取资源通常将因果关系与更广泛的关联混淆，局限于句子级标注，或主要关注显式因果线索，这限制了评估模型恢复生物医学文本中实际表达的因果主张的能力。
AI.method: 构建了 PubMedCausal 语料库，包含来自 PubMed 摘要的 30,000 个段落级数据（其中有 3,945 个因果行和 6,491 个经判定的因果对），每个因果关系都标注了完整的因果跨度、因果类型和句子属性。使用判别式编码器（如 PubMedBERT）和开源生成式模型（如 DeepSeek-R1-32B）在检测和提取任务上进行了基准测试和跨数据集迁移学习评估。
AI.result: 在因果检测中，生物医学编码器表现最好，PubMedBERT 达到了 0.7391 的 F1 分数；在跨度级提取中，表现最好的生成式基线是采用少样本提示的 DeepSeek-R1-32B，其 Cosine Pair F1 达到 0.6765。此外，在外部数据集上的迁移学习评估证明了该语料库支持跨数据集评估。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学因果关系提取在面对类别不平衡、长因果跨度、隐式因果关系、跨句关系和提示敏感性等挑战时，依然非常困难。
AI.translation: 因果关系提取（CRE）是生物医学文本挖掘的核心，但现有的资源往往将因果关系与更广泛的关联混淆，限制在句子级别的标注，或者主要关注显式的因果线索。这限制了它们在评估模型是否能恢复生物医学文本中实际表达的因果主张方面的实用性。我们引入了 PubMedCausal，这是一个基于 PubMed 摘要构建的、用于生物医学 CRE 的跨度级（span-level）标注语料库。该语料库包含 30,000 个段落级行，包括 3,945 个因果行和 6,491 个经裁定的因果对。每个因果关系都标注了全文中的原因和结果跨度、因果关系类型以及句子属性，从而能够评估因果检测和完整跨度因果提取。我们在检测和提取设置中对判别式编码器和开源生成式模型进行了基准测试。对于因果检测，生物医学编码器表现最强，PubMedBERT 的 F1 分数达到 0.7391。对于跨度级提取，最佳的生成式基线是采用少样本提示的 DeepSeek-R1-32B，其 Cosine Pair F1 达到 0.6765。我们通过在外部因果关系数据集上评估经 PubMedCausal 训练的编码器，进一步测试了迁移学习，表明该资源支持跨数据集评估。我们的结果表明，在类别不平衡、长因果跨度、隐式因果关系、跨句关系和提示敏感性下，生物医学 CRE 仍然具有挑战性。代码和数据可在以下网址找到：https://github.com/josiahpaul07/PubMedCausal_Exp。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 PubMedCausal，一个针对生物医学因果关系提取（CRE）的段落级、跨度级标注数据集。该数据集包含 3 万个段落，标注了丰富的因果跨度、类型和跨句特性。作者利用判别式编码器和生成式大模型（如 DeepSeek-R1）对其进行了因果检测和跨度提取的基准测试，并展示了在类别不平衡、隐式因果等复杂场景下该任务的持续挑战性。
AI.keywords: 因果关系提取, 生物医学文本挖掘, 跨度级标注, 语料库, 迁移学习
AI.comments: 该论文填补了生物医学因果关系提取（CRE）领域中缺乏高质量、跨度级、段落级标注数据集的空白。通过细粒度的因果跨度标注，它能更真实地反映医学文本中复杂的因果表达。基准测试中引入了最新的大模型（如 DeepSeek-R1），展示了当前最先进模型在面对医学长文本和隐式因果时的局限性，对未来的研究具有很高的参考价值。

title: Risk-Controlled Lean-as-Judge for Natural-Language Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Lean is increasingly used to judge natural-language mathematical answers, but its signal is partial: many answers never formalize, and a failed proof may reflect an ill-typed statement or a missing library fact, not a wrong answer. On MATH-500 we show this signal is (i) sharply coverage-dependent, that is the proof-winning answer is correct 96% of the time at high proved coverage but 20% at low, and (ii) sparse and often unfaithful: a 7B autoformalizer proves a class for only 28% of problems, and a manual audit finds only approximately 43% of those proofs faithful. We propose COVCAL, a selector over Lean-trace diagnostics that certifies a finite-sample selective-risk bound on accepted answers or abstains, under two regimes (a conservative Bonferroni bound and a tighter dev-then-cal rule). Feasibility depends on autoformalization coverage: with the 7B formalizer the signal is too sparse and Bonferroni abstains on all 20 bootstrap partitions, whereas a prover-specialized formalizer reaches 79% coverage and flips it to feasible on 17 of 20, accepting approximately 48% of problems at 0.98 accepted accuracy. Since self-consistency alone is already 91% accurate, our contribution is a precise account of when, and with which formalizer, a partial formal signal can be trusted under risk control.

AI.title_translation: 针对自然语言数学推理的风险控制 Lean-as-Judge
AI.tldr: 本文指出了使用 Lean 评判自然语言数学答案时信号不完整和不忠实的问题，并提出了 COVCAL 框架，通过风险控制机制来精确确定何时可以信任这些部分形式化的证明信号。
AI.motivation: 尽管 Lean 越来越多地被用于评判自然语言数学解答，但其反馈信号是不完整的（例如，许多解答无法形式化，证明失败可能仅因为类型错误或缺少库事实，而非答案错误）。此外，这种信号高度依赖覆盖率，且往往稀疏和不忠实，因此需要一种方法来控制在信任这些部分形式化信号时的风险。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 COVCAL 的选择器，该选择器运行在 Lean 追踪诊断信息（Lean-trace diagnostics）之上。它在两种机制（保守的 Bonferroni 边界和更紧凑的 dev-then-cal 规则）下，能够对接受的答案证明其有限样本选择性风险边界，或者在无法保证时选择弃权。
AI.result: 在 MATH-500 数据集上，使用 7B 自动形式化器时信号过于稀疏，Bonferroni 机制在所有 20 个自助样本分区上均选择弃权；而使用专为证明器优化的形式化器时，覆盖率提升至 79%，并在 20 个分区中的 17 个上实现了可行性，在 0.98 的接受准确率下接受了大约 48% 的问题（相比之下，仅靠自一致性本身的准确率为 91%）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献在于精确阐述了在风险控制下，何时以及使用哪种形式化器可以信任部分形式化信号，为结合交互式定理证明器与大语言模型进行数学推理评判奠定了可靠的基础。
AI.translation: Lean 正越来越多地被用于评判自然语言数学答案，但其信号是不完整的：许多答案从未被形式化，且失败的证明可能反映了类型错误的陈述或缺失的库事实，而非错误的答案。在 MATH-500 数据集上，我们展示了该信号：（i）强烈依赖覆盖率，即在高证明覆盖率下，赢得证明的答案有 96% 的概率是正确的，但在低覆盖率下仅为 20%；（ii）稀疏且往往不忠实：一个 7B 的自动形式化器仅能为 28% 的问题证明一个类别，且人工审计发现这些证明中仅有约 43% 是忠实的。我们提出了 COVCAL，这是一种针对 Lean 追踪诊断信息的选择器，它在两种机制（保守的 Bonferroni 边界和更紧凑的 dev-then-cal 规则）下，保证接受答案的有限样本选择性风险边界，或选择弃权。可行性取决于自动形式化覆盖率：使用 7B 形式化器时，信号过于稀疏，Bonferroni 在所有 20 个自助样本分区上均选择弃权；而一个专为证明器优化的形式化器达到了 79% 的覆盖率，并在 20 个分区中的 17 个上使其变得可行，在接受准确率为 0.98 时接受了大约 48% 的问题。由于单凭自一致性就已经达到了 91% 的准确率，我们的贡献在于精确阐述了在风险控制下，何时以及使用哪种形式化器可以信任部分形式化信号。
AI.summary: 本文研究了使用交互式定理证明器 Lean 作为自然语言数学推理评判裁判的可靠性问题。作者发现 Lean 提供的评判信号存在覆盖率依赖性、稀疏性和不忠实性。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了 COVCAL 选择器，通过 Bonferroni 边界和 dev-then-cal 规则在风险控制下决定是否接受 Lean 的评判结果或选择弃权。实验表明，通过提高自动形式化器的覆盖率，COVCAL 能够在保持高准确率（0.98）的同时接受接近半数的问题，从而实现了安全、可信的部分形式化信号评判。
AI.keywords: 自动形式化, 风险控制, Lean-as-Judge, 数学推理, 选择性预测
AI.comments: 该研究具有很强的实用价值和理论意义。其创新之处在于首次系统性地量化了“Lean-as-Judge”（使用交互式定理证明器Lean作为自然语言数学解答的裁判）在评估时面临的信号不完整、稀疏及不忠实问题，并引入了选择性预测和风险控制框架（COVCAL）来提供统计安全保证。局限性在于，该方法的实用性高度依赖于自动形式化器的性能，在形式化能力较弱时（如普通的7B模型）系统会频繁弃权，这表明未来研究仍需聚焦于提升形式化模型的覆盖率和保真度。

title: Safety-Critical Adaptive Impedance Control via Nonsmooth Control Barrier Functions under State and Input Constraints
summary: Safe physical interaction is critical for deploying robotic manipulators in human-robot interaction and contact-rich tasks, where uncertainty, external forces, and actuator limitations can compromise both performance and safety. We propose an online adaptive impedance control framework that enforces joint-state safety while achieving compliant interaction under uncertain dynamics. The approach combines a quadratic-program-based safety filter with a novel composed position-velocity non-smooth control barrier function (NCBF), enabling joint position and velocity constraints to be enforced through a unified relative-degree-one barrier. Unknown dynamics are compensated online using an interval type-2 fuzzy logic system, while actuator torque limits are handled through soft constraints with exact penalty recovery of feasible solutions. A disturbance-observer-enhanced safety mechanism improves robustness against modelling errors and external interaction forces. Using composite Lyapunov analysis, we prove forward invariance of the safe set and the uniform ultimately boundedness of the impedance-tracking error. Simulations on a 7-DOF manipulator with severe parametric uncertainty and external interaction wrenches demonstrate safe constraint satisfaction and robust impedance tracking.

AI.title_translation: 状态与输入约束下基于非光滑控制屏障函数的安全关键自适应阻抗控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合非光滑控制屏障函数与模糊逻辑系统的自适应阻抗控制框架，能在状态和转矩限制下确保机器人交互的安全与鲁棒跟踪。
AI.motivation: 在人机交互和富接触任务中，机器人的不确定性、外部干扰力以及执行器物理限制（如转矩极限）极易损害系统的安全性和操作性能，因此亟需一种能在状态和输入约束下确保安全且具备良好顺从性的在线自适应阻抗控制方法。
AI.method: 提出一种在线自适应阻抗控制框架，核心方法包括：1) 结合二次规划（QP）安全滤波器与新型组合位置-速度非光滑控制屏障函数（NCBF），实现关节位置和速度约束的统一管理；2) 使用区间二型模糊逻辑系统在线补偿未知动力学；3) 采用带精确惩罚恢复的软约束来处理执行器转矩限制；4) 引入扰动观测器增强安全机制以对抗建模误差和外力。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了安全集的正前向不变性以及阻抗跟踪误差的一致最终有界性。在具有严重参数不确定性和外部交互力矩的7自由度机械臂上的仿真结果表明，该方案成功实现了关节状态约束的严格满足和鲁棒的阻抗跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 通过复合李雅普诺夫分析和7自由度机械臂的仿真实验，证明了该控制框架能够有效确保安全集的正前向不变性，并保证阻抗跟踪误差的一致最终有界，实现了高要求的安全约束满足和鲁棒阻抗跟踪。
AI.translation: 安全的物理交互对于在人机交互和富接触任务中部署机器人操纵器至关重要，在这些任务中，不确定性、外部力和执行器限制可能会损害系统性能和安全性。我们提出了一种在线自适应阻抗控制框架，该框架在不确定动力学下实现顺从交互的同时，强制执行关节状态安全。该方法将基于二次规划的安全滤波器与一种新型的组合位置-速度非光滑控制屏障函数（NCBF）相结合，从而能够通过统一的一阶相对度屏障来强制执行关节位置和速度约束。利用区间二型模糊逻辑系统在线补偿未知动力学，同时通过具有可行解精确惩罚恢复的软约束来处理执行器转矩限制。一种由扰动观测器增强的安全机制提高了系统对建模误差和外部交互力的鲁棒性。利用复合李雅普诺夫分析，我们证明了安全集的正前向不变性以及阻抗跟踪误差的一致最终有界性。在具有严重参数不确定性和外部交互力矩的7自由度机械臂上的仿真表明，该方法实现了安全约束满足和鲁棒阻抗跟踪。
AI.summary: 本文针对存在动力学不确定性、外力干扰及执行器限制的机器人，提出了一种安全关键的在线自适应阻抗控制框架。该框架利用基于二次规划的安全滤波器和新型非光滑控制屏障函数（NCBF），将关节位置与速度约束统一为一阶相对度屏障进行处理。通过区间二型模糊逻辑系统补偿未知动力学，并结合软约束处理转矩极限，同时利用扰动观测器提升鲁棒性。理论与仿真均验证了该方法在保障安全约束和实现鲁棒阻抗跟踪方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 自适应阻抗控制, 非光滑控制屏障函数, 状态与输入约束, 机器人安全交互, 模糊逻辑系统
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种新型的组合位置-速度非光滑控制屏障函数（NCBF），将二阶约束转化为一阶相对度屏障进行统一处理，简化了控制设计。同时，结合区间二型模糊逻辑系统和扰动观测器，有效解决了实际机器人控制中面临的动力学不确定性、执行器物理极限及外部交互力干扰等多重挑战，具有很高的学术价值和应用前景。

title: LEIA: Learned Environment for Interactive Architected Materials
summary: World models have enabled interactive exploration of game environments and robotic manipulation, but physical engineering remains beyond their reach: real materials exhibit nonlinear constitutive laws, carry history-dependent internal state, undergo inertial dynamics, and may possess hierarchical structures spanning multiple length scales. We present LEIA (Learned Environment for Interactive Architected materials), a world model that lets engineers apply boundary conditions step by step and observe the resulting deformation and stress fields in real time. LEIA handles large three-dimensional unstructured meshes and generates autoregressive responses to user-specified loading. We introduce MicroPlate, a benchmark of architected plates spanning two regimes of microstructure modeling: architected lattices that resolve microstructure explicitly through three-dimensional geometry, and a homogeneous plate where microstructural change is modeled implicitly through internal degrees of freedom. MicroPlate is used to assess LEIA alongside four baseline methods across both regimes. Finally, we demonstrate that LEIA enables efficient candidate generation and ranking for fast surrogate-guided search for de novo designs of architected materials, with stress-accurate candidate ranking validated by finite element ground truth.

AI.title_translation: LEIA：用于交互式构筑材料的学习型环境
AI.tldr: 提出LEIA世界模型，可实时模拟三维材料在逐步加载下的变形与应力，并能高效加速新材料的设计搜索。
AI.motivation: 尽管世界模型在游戏和机器人领域取得了成功，但由于真实材料具有非线性本构关系、历史相关的内部状态、惯性动力学以及跨尺度的分级结构，物理工程领域仍难以应用世界模型进行实时交互。
AI.method: 提出了LEIA世界模型，该模型能够处理大型三维无结构网格，并对用户指定的加载生成自回归响应。同时，引入了MicroPlate基准（包含显式几何晶格和隐式均匀化板两种微结构建模方案）来评估LEIA及四种基准方法。最后，展示了LEIA在代理引导的从头设计搜索中进行快速候选生成和排序的应用。
AI.result: LEIA能够实时、自回归地预测三维无结构网格在逐步边界条件下的变形和应力场，在MicroPlate基准测试中表现优于四种基准方法，并能够实现应力准确的候选设计排序，该排序结果得到了有限元地面真值的验证。
AI.conclusion: LEIA成功将世界模型扩展到了物理工程领域，为工程师提供了实时交互式的材料模拟工具，并为构筑材料的快速代理引导搜索和从头设计提供了高效且准确的候选生成与排序能力。
AI.translation: 世界模型已经实现了游戏环境和机器人操作的交互式探索，但物理工程仍超出了它们的能力范围：真实材料表现出非线性本构关系，携带与历史相关的内部状态，经历惯性动力学，并且可能拥有跨越多个长度尺度的分级结构。我们提出了 LEIA（用于交互式构筑材料的学习型环境），这是一个允许工程师逐步施加边界条件并实时观察由此产生的变形和应力场的世界模型。LEIA 能够处理大型三维无结构网格，并对用户指定的加载生成自回归响应。我们引入了 MicroPlate，这是一个构筑板的基准，涵盖了微结构建模的两个范式：通过三维几何显式解析微结构的构筑晶格，以及通过内部自由度隐式建模微结构变化的均匀化板。MicroPlate 被用于评估 LEIA 以及这两种范式下的四种基准方法。最后，我们证明了 LEIA 能够为构筑材料的从头设计进行快速、代理引导的搜索，实现高效的候选生成和排序，并且其应力准确的候选排序已通过有限元地面真值验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LEIA（用于交互式构筑材料的学习型环境），这是一个专为物理工程设计的世界模型，能够实时、自回归地模拟三维无结构网格在逐步加载下的变形和应力场。作者还引入了MicroPlate基准来评估该模型，并证明了LEIA能够显著加速构筑材料的从头设计搜索。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 构筑材料, 实时物理模拟, 代理引导设计, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文将人工智能中的“世界模型”概念成功拓展至固体力学与材料工程领域，具有很强的跨学科创新性。它解决了复杂三维材料实时交互式物理模拟的难题，对于加速先进构筑材料的逆向设计具有重要意义。其局限性在于，对于极度复杂的非线性材料行为，其自回归预测的物理保真度可能仍需依赖高精度的有限元地面真值进行最终验证。

title: CyberJurors: A Multi-Agent Simulation Task for E-Commerce Disputes Verdict
summary: E-commerce platforms have begun recruiting crowdsourced jurors to adjudicate massive volumes of transaction disputes. Unlike formal legal judgment, E-commerce dispute verdicts require grounding pivotal clues from redundant, multi-round, multimodal evidence and making decisions under flexible platform-specific conventions. These characteristics render existing methods insufficient for this scenario. To bridge this gap, we introduce a pioneering task, E-commerce Dispute Verdicts (EDV), and present VerdictBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising 6,000 real-world cases designed to reflect crowdsourced jury decisions. Building upon this, we propose CyberJurors, a multi-agent framework to clarify the dispute logic and regulate the verdict process. At the individual level, Individual Verdict Chain-of-Thought decomposes the EDV task into four structured reasoning stages, enabling fine-grained clue perception and clarifying causal logic between pivotal clues and the dispute focus. At the collective level, Jury Consensus Verdict simulates multi-round discussion and voting among jurors, while incorporating verdict precedents to mitigate cognitive biases toward either disputant. Experiments on VerdictBench show that CyberJurors outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs, MLLMs, and court simulators, while achieving stronger alignment with real-world jury voting patterns. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/YanhuiS/CyberJurors and https://huggingface.co/datasets/piggi/VerdictBench.

AI.title_translation: CyberJurors：用于电子商务纠纷裁决的多智能体模拟任务
AI.tldr: 本文提出了电商纠纷裁决（EDV）任务和VerdictBench多模态基准，并设计了CyberJurors多智能体框架，通过个体思维链推理与集体共识协商模拟，显著提升了电商纠纷裁决的准确性与人类对齐度。
AI.motivation: 传统的正式法律判决方法无法直接应用于电子商务纠纷裁决。因为电商纠纷裁决需要从冗余的、多轮的、多模态的证据中定位关键线索，并且必须在灵活的、特定于平台的规则约束下做出决策。现有的方法在这一复杂场景下显得力不从心。
AI.method:
1. 提出了电子商务纠纷裁决（EDV）任务，并构建了包含6,000个真实案例的多模态基准数据集VerdictBench。
2. 提出了多智能体模拟框架CyberJurors，包含两个层面：
   - 个体层面：采用“个人裁决思维链（Individual Verdict CoT）”，将裁决任务分解为四个结构化的推理阶段，以进行细粒度的线索感知并厘清因果逻辑。
   - 集体层面：采用“陪审团共识裁决（Jury Consensus Verdict）”，模拟陪审员之间的多轮讨论和投票，并引入历史裁决先例以减少对纠纷任何一方的认知偏差。
AI.result: 在VerdictBench基准上的实验表明，CyberJurors框架的性能显著优于现有的最先进大语言模型（LLMs）、多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）以及法庭模拟器，并且在投票模式上与真实世界中人类陪审团展现出更强的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功定义了电子商务纠纷裁决（EDV）这一新任务，并构建了相应的多模态基准VerdictBench。通过提出CyberJurors多智能体框架，证明了结合个体结构化推理与集体共识协商机制能够有效解决复杂的电商交易纠纷，为多智能体协同决策提供了新的范式。
AI.translation: 电子商务平台已经开始招募众包陪审员来裁决海量的交易纠纷。与正式的法律判决不同，电子商务纠纷裁决需要从冗余的、多轮的、多模态的证据中定位关键线索，并在灵活的、特定于平台的惯例下做出决策。这些特点使得现有方法不足以应对这一场景。为了弥补这一空白，我们引入了一项开创性的任务——电子商务纠纷裁决（EDV），并提出了VerdictBench，这是一个包含6,000个真实案例的多模态基准，旨在反映众包陪审员的决策。在此基础上，我们提出了CyberJurors，这是一个用于澄清纠纷逻辑并规范裁决过程的多智能体框架。在个体层面，“个人裁决思维链”将EDV任务分解为四个结构化的推理阶段，从而实现细粒度的线索感知，并阐明关键线索与纠纷焦点之间的因果逻辑。在集体层面，“陪审团共识裁决”模拟了陪审员之间的多轮讨论和投票，同时引入裁决先例以减轻对任何一方争议当事人的认知偏差。在VerdictBench上的实验表明，CyberJurors的表现优于最先进的大语言模型（LLMs）、多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）和法庭模拟器，同时与现实世界中陪审团的投票模式达成了更强的一致性。代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/YanhuiS/CyberJurors 和 https://huggingface.co/datasets/piggi/VerdictBench 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对电商平台众包陪审员解决交易纠纷的场景，首次提出了“电子商务纠纷裁决（EDV）”任务，并推出了包含6,000个真实多模态案例的基准数据集VerdictBench。为了应对证据冗余和规则多变的挑战，作者开发了CyberJurors多智能体框架，该框架通过个体的四阶段思维链推理和集体的多轮讨论、投票及先例参考机制，实现了高精度的纠纷裁决模拟。实验结果证实了该框架在准确率和人类对齐度上的优越性。
AI.keywords: 电子商务纠纷裁决, 多智能体模拟, 多模态基准, 众包陪审团, 思维链推理
AI.comments:
1. 创新性地将研究视角从传统法庭审判拓展到电商众包纠纷裁决，这一场景具有多模态、多轮交互和规则灵活等独特挑战，填补了现有研究的空白。
2. 提出的CyberJurors框架设计巧妙，在个体层面使用四阶段思维链进行深度线索剖析，在集体层面模拟多轮讨论、投票并引入历史先例，有效缓解了认知偏差。
3. 提供了包含6,000个真实案例的高质量多模态基准数据集VerdictBench，对后续结合大模型与群体智能的研究具有重要的推动作用。

title: From paper to benchmark: agentic, framework-based reproduction of under-specified methods in machine health intelligence
summary: Industrial Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) provides a representative case study for a broader challenge in applied machine learning: translating published papers into executable, benchmark-ready implementations. Reproducing under-specified methods in PHM is particularly difficult due to restricted access to industrial datasets, incomplete reporting of preprocessing and evaluation protocols, and implicit design choices (e.g., windowing, target construction, data splits) that critically affect performance. Existing paper-to-code systems generate implementations for individual papers, but these artifacts are often not directly comparable due to inconsistencies in assumptions and evaluation settings. We introduce \emph{agentic, framework-based PHM paper reproduction}, where an agent translates a paper into a shared PHM benchmark framework via a \emph{slot-binding interface}. This interface maps equations and protocol descriptions into structured components (task definitions, dataset adapters, windowing, targets, models, and evaluators), while explicitly recording unresolved assumptions. The resulting implementations are validated against standardized task contracts and evaluation hooks, enabling consistent and comparable benchmarking. We evaluate this approach on 16 PHM papers, comparing framework-enhanced, skill-based and prompt-based agentic reproduction against a recent framework-free paper-reproduction agent. We assess reproduction success, model-based code evaluation, framework binding of paper assumptions, and cross-paper benchmark comparability under standardized protocols. Our results show that coupling agentic generation with a shared framework transforms paper reproduction from isolated code synthesis into executable, assumption-aware, and systematically comparable benchmark implementations.

AI.title_translation: 从论文到基准：机器健康智能中对描述不详方法的智能体化、基于框架的复现
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于框架的智能体化论文复现方法，通过插槽绑定接口将论文转化为统一的PHM基准框架，实现了对描述不详方法的系统化、可比性复现。
AI.motivation: 在工业预测与健康管理（PHM）等领域，复现描述不详的学术论文方法面临巨大挑战。由于数据集受限、预处理和评估协议报告不完整以及隐式设计选择（如窗口化、数据划分等），现有“论文到代码”系统生成的实现往往因假设和评估设置的不一致而无法直接进行横向对比。
AI.method: 提出了一种“基于框架的智能体化PHM论文复现”方法。该方法使用智能体通过一个“插槽绑定接口”（slot-binding interface）将论文翻译并嵌入到一个共享的PHM基准框架中。该接口将公式和协议描述映射为结构化组件（任务定义、数据集适配器、窗口化、目标、模型和评估器），同时显式记录未解决的假设，并通过标准化的任务契约和评估钩子进行验证。
AI.result: 在16篇PHM论文上的评估结果表明，将智能体生成与共享框架相结合，成功将论文复现从孤立的代码合成转化为可执行、感知假设且具有系统可比性的基准测试实现。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体代码生成与共享的基准测试框架相结合，能够有效解决描述不详方法的复现难题，实现一致且可比的基准测试。
AI.translation: 工业预测与健康管理（PHM）为应用机器学习中一个更广泛的挑战提供了一个具有代表性的案例研究：将已发表的论文转化为可执行的、可用于基准测试的实现。由于工业数据集的访问受限、预处理和评估协议的报告不完整，以及对性能有关键影响的隐式设计选择（例如窗口化、目标构建、数据划分），在PHM中复现描述不详的方法尤为困难。现有的“论文到代码”系统为单篇论文生成实现，但由于假设和评估设置的不一致，这些产物通常无法直接进行比较。我们引入了“基于框架的智能体化PHM论文复现”，其中智能体通过插槽绑定接口将论文转化为共享的PHM基准框架。该接口将公式和协议描述映射为结构化组件（任务定义、数据集适配器、窗口化、目标、模型和评估器），同时显式记录未解决的假设。生成的实现针对标准化的任务契约和评估钩子进行验证，从而实现一致且可比的基准测试。我们在16篇PHM论文上评估了该方法，将框架增强的、基于技能的和基于提示的智能体化复现与最近的无框架论文复现智能体进行了对比。我们评估了复现成功率、基于模型的代码评估、论文假设的框架绑定以及标准化协议下的跨论文基准可比性。我们的结果表明，将智能体生成与共享框架相结合，将论文复现从孤立的代码合成转变为可执行的、感知假设的、且具有系统可比性的基准实现。
AI.summary: 本文针对工业预测与健康管理（PHM）领域论文复现中由于描述不详、假设不一致导致无法进行标准化对比的问题，提出了一种基于框架的智能体化复现方法。该方法利用智能体通过插槽绑定接口将论文内容映射为共享基准框架中的结构化组件，并显式记录未知假设。实验在16篇PHM论文上验证了该方法的有效性，表明其能将孤立的代码生成转化为系统化、可对比的基准测试实现。
AI.keywords: 论文复现, 智能体, 基准测试, 预测与健康管理, 软件框架
AI.comments: 该论文创新地将大语言模型（LLM）智能体与统一的领域基准框架（PHM）相结合，解决了传统AI代码生成工具仅能生成孤立代码、无法进行公平横向对比的痛点。插槽绑定接口的设计非常巧妙，不仅规范了代码结构，还显式捕获了论文中未提及的隐式假设。其局限性可能在于对高度自定义或超出框架既有插槽定义的新颖算法结构的适应性，且对基础LLM的推理和代码生成能力有较高依赖。

title: Teacher-Student Representational Alignment for Reinforcement Learning-Driven Imitation Learning
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted as an oral presentation at the RL4IL Workshop at ICRA 2026
summary: Imitation learning (IL) from a state-based reinforcement learning (RL) policy is a common approach to overcome the curse of dimensionality in complex and high-dimensional observation spaces prevalent in robotics. This paper addresses the irreducible imitation gap that emerges when teacher and student are learned in isolation, and the teacher policy has the liberty to rely on privileged state information that the student cannot infer from its observations. Instead of improving poor student performance with RL finetuning after IL, which often requires a whole new training setup, we propose a novel algorithm which learns a shared embedding space that hides agent-specific observations and thus trains imitable teacher policies by construction. We train the shared embedding space with self-supervised contrastive learning in parallel to the teacher policy and prevent it from extracting private information by limiting its gradients from updating the encoder networks. We perform evaluations on several example domains and compare to state-of-the-art baselines showing that our algorithm enables higher student performance with substantially reduced imitation gap.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted as an oral presentation at the RL4IL Workshop at ICRA 2026

AI.title_translation: 强化学习驱动的模仿学习中的师生表征对齐
AI.tldr: 提出一种通过自监督对比学习构建共享嵌入空间的新算法，对齐教师与学生的表征并隐蔽私有信息，从而在不依赖后期强化学习微调的情况下，显著缩小模仿差距并提升学生性能。
AI.motivation: 在机器人等高维观察空间中，从基于状态的强化学习（RL）教师策略中进行模仿学习（IL）是常用方法。然而，当教师和学生被隔离训练时，教师会依赖学生无法获取的特权状态信息，导致出现无法消除的“模仿差距”（imitation gap）。现有通过后期RL微调来弥补差距的方法通常需要繁琐的全新训练设置。
AI.method: 提出了一种新算法，在与教师策略并行训练的过程中，利用自监督对比学习来学习一个共享的嵌入空间。该空间隐藏了智能体特定的观察，从而在构建上训练出可模仿的教师策略。同时，通过限制梯度更新编码器网络，防止该空间提取私有信息。
AI.result: 在多个示例领域的评估和与最先进基线方法的对比表明，该算法能够使学生智能体获得更高的性能，并大幅缩小模仿差距。
AI.conclusion: 提出的师生表征对齐算法能够有效克服因教师和学生信息不对称导致的模仿差距，无需在模仿学习后进行繁琐的强化学习微调，便能显著提升学生策略的性能。
AI.translation: 从基于状态的强化学习（RL）策略中进行模仿学习（IL）是克服机器人技术中常见的高维和复杂观察空间中维度灾难的常用方法。本文解决了当教师和学生被孤立地学习时出现的不可消除的模仿差距，此时教师策略可以自由地依赖学生无法从其观察中推断出的特权状态信息。我们没有通过在模仿学习后进行RL微调（这通常需要全新的训练设置）来改善较差的学生表现，而是提出了一种新算法，该算法学习一个隐藏了智能体特定观察的共享嵌入空间，从而在构建时就训练出可模仿的教师策略。我们在训练教师策略的同时，利用自监督对比学习来训练共享嵌入空间，并通过限制其梯度更新编码器网络来防止其提取私有信息。我们在多个示例领域进行了评估，并与最先进的基准进行了比较，结果表明我们的算法能够实现更高的学生性能，并显著减小了模仿差距。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于强化学习的模仿学习中，因教师拥有特权信息而导致与学生产生“模仿差距”的问题，提出了一种师生表征对齐算法。该算法利用自监督对比学习在训练教师策略的同时构建一个共享嵌入空间，从而隐蔽智能体特有的私有观察。实验表明，该方法在无需后期强化学习微调的情况下，显著提升了学生的模仿性能并缩小了模仿差距。
AI.keywords: 模仿学习, 强化学习, 表征对齐, 对比学习, 模仿差距
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于通过在表征层面（共享嵌入空间）对齐教师和学生，从源头上解决了模仿学习中的信息不对称问题，避免了后期繁琐的强化学习微调。其巧妙之处在于利用自监督对比学习来隐蔽私有观察，并通过限制梯度更新来防止私有信息泄露。局限性在于，在极其复杂的实际机器人任务中，如何保证共享嵌入空间在丢弃私有信息的同时，仍能保留足够的有用特征以维持教师策略的高性能，可能还需要更广泛的验证。

title: PrionNER: A Named Entity Recognition Dataset for Prion Disease Biomedical Literature
comments: 29 pages, 5 figures, accepted at ACL 25th Workshop on Biomedical Language Processing (BioNLP 2026)
summary: Prion diseases are rare, rapidly progressive, and fatal neurodegenerative disorders that remain difficult to diagnose, particularly in their early stages because of nonspecific clinical presentations. However, to our knowledge, there is no publicly available prion-disease-focused dataset designed to capture a broad range of clinically relevant entities from the biomedical literature. We introduce PrionNER, a manually annotated named entity recognition dataset for prion disease clinical information in PubMed abstracts. The current release comprises 317 abstracts, 2,943 sentences, and 6,955 text-bound entity annotations spanning 15 coarse-grained and 31 fine-grained clinically oriented entity types covering diseases, symptoms, diagnostics, findings, anatomy, treatments, and temporal and statistical evidence. Inter-annotator agreement reaches 81.78 exact-match F1, indicating strong annotation consistency. We benchmark supervised BERT baselines, W2NER, and zero-shot extractors on PrionNER. W2NER is the strongest supervised model, and Gemma-4-31B is the strongest zero-shot model, but the benchmark remains challenging, especially for structurally complex mentions and fine-grained clinically adjacent label distinctions. PrionNER provides a clinically grounded benchmark for prion-disease information extraction and supports research on rare-disease biomedical NLP under low-resource, fine-grained, and non-flat extraction conditions. The dataset, annotation guidelines, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/daotuanan/PrionNER/.
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, accepted at ACL 25th Workshop on Biomedical Language Processing (BioNLP 2026)

AI.title_translation: PrionNER：用于朊病毒病生物医学文献的命名实体识别数据集
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PrionNER，这是一个针对朊病毒病临床信息的首个公开命名实体识别（NER）数据集，包含317篇PubMed摘要，提供了15个粗粒度和31个细粒度实体类型，并对多种监督和零样本模型进行了基准测试。
AI.motivation: 朊病毒病诊断困难，且目前缺乏公开的、专注于捕捉生物医学文献中广泛临床相关实体的朊病毒病专用数据集。
AI.method: 引入并手动标注了针对PubMed摘要中朊病毒病临床信息的命名实体识别数据集PrionNER。该数据集包含317篇摘要、2,943个句子和6,955个文本绑定实体标注，涵盖15个粗粒度和31个细粒度临床导向实体类型。此外，还使用监督BERT基线、W2NER和零样本提取器在PrionNER上进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 标注者间一致性达到81.78的精确匹配F1值。在基准测试中，W2NER是表现最强的监督模型，Gemma-4-31B是最强的零样本模型，但该基准对于结构复杂的提及和细粒度临床相邻标签区分仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: PrionNER为朊病毒病信息提取提供了一个立足临床的基准，并支持在低资源、细粒度和非扁平提取条件下对罕见病生物医学自然语言处理（NLP）的研究。
AI.translation: 朊病毒病是一种罕见、进展迅速且致命的神经退行性疾病，由于其临床表现不特异，特别是在早期阶段，诊断仍然十分困难。然而，据我们所知，目前还没有公开的、旨在从生物医学文献中捕捉广泛临床相关实体的朊病毒病专用数据集。我们介绍了PrionNER，这是一个针对PubMed摘要中朊病毒病临床信息的手动标注命名实体识别数据集。当前发布的版本包含317篇摘要、2,943个句子和6,955个文本绑定实体标注，跨越了15个粗粒度和31个细粒度的临床导向实体类型，涵盖疾病、症状、诊断、检查结果、解剖、治疗以及时间和统计证据。标注者间一致性达到了81.78的精确匹配F1值，表明了极强的标注一致性。我们在PrionNER上对监督BERT基线、W2NER和零样本提取器进行了基准测试。W2NER是最强的监督模型，而Gemma-4-31B是最强的零样本模型，但该基准仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于结构复杂的提及和细粒度临床相邻标签的区分。PrionNER为朊病毒病信息提取提供了一个立足临床的基准，并支持在低资源、细粒度和非扁平（non-flat）提取条件下的罕见病生物医学自然语言处理（NLP）研究。该数据集、标注指南和评估脚本可在 https://github.com/daotuanan/PrionNER/ 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PrionNER，这是首个用于朊病毒病临床信息提取的手动标注命名实体识别（NER）数据集。该数据集包含317篇PubMed摘要，涵盖15个粗粒度和31个细粒度的临床实体类型。作者在PrionNER上对多种监督（如BERT、W2NER）和零样本（如Gemma-4-31B）模型进行了基准评估，结果表明该数据集为低资源、细粒度罕见病生物医学NLP研究提供了一个具有挑战性且实用的基准。
AI.keywords: Prion diseases, Named entity recognition, Biomedical NLP, Rare-disease dataset
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：填补了罕见病（特别是朊病毒病）领域缺乏高质量、临床级细粒度NER数据集的空白。
2. 重要性：提供了多达31个细粒度的实体类型（涵盖症状、诊断、解剖等），有利于支持精细的临床知识抽取，对低资源、非扁平（重叠）实体提取研究具有重要价值。
3. 局限性：数据集规模相对较小（317篇摘要），这在罕见病领域是常见限制，但可能会限制更大型深度学习模型的泛化能力。

title: Preconditioned Discontinuous Galerkin Method for Elliptic Interface Problem on Unfitted Mesh with Reconstructed Discontinuous Approximation
summary: In this paper, we develop an efficient preconditioned unfitted finite element method for the elliptic interface problem, based on the reconstructed discontinuous approximation. The approximation method for interface problems is originally proposed in [Li et al. SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 42(2), 2020], in which an arbitrarily high-order approximation space with one degree of freedom per element is constructed by solving local least squares fitting problems. The space can be applied within the cut discontinuous Galerkin framework, where the jump conditions across the interface are weakly enforced by the Nitsche's penalty method. In this work, the local least squares problem is modified by introducing appropriate constraints, which allows us to naturally ensure the stability near the interface by the reconstructed space, and further enables us to establish a norm equivalence between the high-order space and the lowest-order space. This equivalence property motivates us to construct a preconditioner from the piecewise constant space, and this preconditioning method is shown to be optimal in the sense that the upper bound of the condition number of the preconditioned system is independent of the mesh size, the coefficient and the interface location relative to the unfitted mesh. We also present the multigrid algorithms that serve as the inverse of the lowest-order system matrix. Numerical experiments in both two and three dimensions confirm the optimal convergence rates under error measurements and illustrate the efficiency and the robustness of the preconditioning method.

AI.title_translation: 基于重构间断逼近的非贴体网格椭圆界面问题预条件间断伽辽金方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对椭圆界面问题的预条件非贴体有限元方法，通过引入约束的重构间断逼近建立了高低阶空间范数等价性，并设计了最优预条件子。
AI.motivation: 旨在为求解椭圆界面问题的非贴体有限元方法（基于重构间断逼近）开发一种高效的预条件技术，以解决界面附近的稳定性问题，并消除网格尺寸、系数及界面位置对系统条件数的影响，提高计算效率。
AI.method:
1. 通过在局部最小二乘问题中引入适当的约束来修改重构间断逼近，从而自然地确保界面附近的稳定性；
2. 建立高阶空间与最低阶（分片常数）空间之间的范数等价性；
3. 基于分片常数空间构造预条件子，并利用多网格算法作为最低阶系统矩阵的逆。
AI.result:
1. 理论上证明了预条件系统的条件数上界与网格步长、物理系数以及界面相对于非贴体网格的位置无关（即具有最优性）；
2. 二维和三维数值实验证实了在误差测量下具有最优收敛速度，并验证了该预条件方法的效率和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的预条件方法对于非贴体网格上的椭圆界面问题具有最优性、高效性和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们基于重构间断逼近，针对椭圆界面问题开发了一种高效的预条件非贴体有限元方法。该界面问题的逼近方法最初由 [Li et al. SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 42(2), 2020] 提出，其中通过求解局部最小二乘拟合问题，构造了每个单元具有一个自由度的任意高阶逼近空间。该空间可应用于切片间断伽辽金（cut DG）框架，其中跨界面的跳跃条件通过 Nitsche 惩罚法弱式施加。在这项工作中，我们通过引入适当的约束修改了局部最小二乘问题，这使我们能够通过重构空间自然地确保界面附近的稳定性，并进一步使我们能够在高阶空间和最低阶空间之间建立范数等价性。这种等价性质促使我们从分片常数空间构造一个预条件子，并且该预条件方法被证明是最优的，因为预条件系统的条件数上界与网格尺寸、物理系数以及界面相对于非贴体网格的位置无关。我们还提出了多网格算法，用作最低阶系统矩阵的逆。在二维和三维中的数值实验证实了误差测量下的最优收敛速度，并说明了该预条件方法的效率和鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文针对椭圆界面问题，提出了一种基于重构间断逼近的高效预条件非贴体有限元方法。通过在局部最小二乘重构中引入适当约束，该方法不仅保证了界面附近的计算稳定性，还建立了高阶空间与最低阶空间之间的范数等价性。基于此等价性，作者设计了一个源自分片常数空间的预条件子，并结合多网格算法进行求解。理论分析和2D/3D数值实验表明，该预条件子具有最优性，其条件数上界与网格尺寸、物理系数和界面位置无关，且表现出极高的计算效率和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 椭圆界面问题, 非贴体网格, 间断伽辽金法, 重构间断逼近, 预条件子
AI.comments: 该论文的重要贡献在于通过约束局部最小二乘问题，优雅地解决了非贴体网格在界面附近的稳定性难题，并巧妙地利用高低阶空间范数等价性构造了最优预条件子。这一方法显著降低了高阶非贴体方法的计算开销，对于椭圆界面问题的数值求解具有很强的实用价值和理论创新性。

title: Meta-Attention: Bayesian Per-Token Routing for Efficient Transformer Inference
summary: Standard transformer architectures apply a single attention mechanism uniformly across all tokens and sequence positions, irrespective of local context or computational budget. We propose Meta-Attention, a framework that dynamically routes each token to the most appropriate attention strategy -- full softmax attention, linear (kernel) attention, or sliding-window local attention -- via a Bayesian Meta-Controller. Unlike prior routing approaches that use deterministic or prior-free learned routing, the Meta-Controller treats per-token mechanism selection as posterior inference under a compute-aware Dirichlet prior: routing weights are the output of an amortised variational posterior q(alpha | x_t; phi) trained with an Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) objective that jointly encodes task performance and attention-mechanism cost. This design produces principled routing uncertainty estimates that govern the soft-to-hard routing transition, mitigates routing collapse without ad hoc load-balancing losses, and yields better compute-performance trade-offs than deterministic or prior-free learned routing at negligible overhead. Phase 1 empirical results on a Tiny LM benchmark confirm core predictions: the Bayesian controller's learned routing distribution implies a projected normalised FLOP cost of 25.1% under hard routing, vs. 59.3% for the prior-free baseline (-34.2 pp), and reduces routing entropy from 55.8% to 43.3% (-12.5 pp), demonstrating that the Dirichlet prior prevents routing collapse while the non-Bayesian model defaults to full attention. We present the Bayesian architecture, ELBO training objective, and a Phase 1 PyTorch prototype validating forward-pass correctness, posterior diversity, and a controlled ablation against a prior-free baseline. Code available at: https://github.com/KFEAL/meta-attention

AI.title_translation: 元注意力：用于高效Transformer推理的贝叶斯逐Token路由
AI.tldr: 本文提出Meta-Attention框架，通过贝叶斯元控制器和狄利克雷先验，动态为每个token选择最经济高效的注意力机制，在防止路由崩溃的同时显著降低了Transformer的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 标准的Transformer架构在所有token和序列位置上统一应用单一的注意力机制，忽略了局部上下文的差异或计算预算的限制，导致推理效率低下。现有的路由方法多采用确定性或无先验的学习路由，容易导致路由崩溃且缺乏不确定性估计。
AI.method: 提出Meta-Attention框架。该框架使用一个贝叶斯元控制器（Bayesian Meta-Controller）将逐token的注意力机制选择（全Softmax、线性或滑动窗口注意力）建模为在计算感知狄利克雷先验下的后验推断。路由权重是通过摊销变分后验联合训练得到的，并使用联合编码任务性能和注意力机制成本的证据下界（ELBO）作为优化目标。
AI.result: 在Tiny LM基准上的第一阶段实证结果表明，在硬路由下，贝叶斯控制器学习到的路由分布使投影归一化FLOP成本降至25.1%（而无先验基线为59.3%，降低了34.2个百分点），同时将路由熵从55.8%降低到43.3%（降低了12.5个百分点）。这表明狄利克雷先验能有效防止路由崩溃，而无先验基线则会退化为全注意力。此外，PyTorch原型验证了前向传播的正确性、后验多样性及消融实验的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯元控制器能够提供原则性的路由不确定性估计，控制软硬路由的过渡，在无需传统负载均衡损失的情况下有效缓解路由崩溃，并以极低的计算开销实现比确定性或无先验学习路由更好的计算-性能权衡。
AI.translation: 标准的 Transformer 架构在所有 token 和序列位置上统一应用单一的注意力机制，而不考虑局部上下文或计算预算。我们提出了 Meta-Attention（元注意力），这是一个通过贝叶斯元控制器（Bayesian Meta-Controller）将每个 token 动态路由到最合适注意力策略（全 softmax 注意力、线性/核注意力或滑动窗口局部注意力）的框架。与以往使用确定性或无先验学习路由的方法不同，该元控制器将逐 token 的机制选择视为在计算感知狄利克雷先验下的后验推断：路由权重是通过证据下界（ELBO）目标训练的摊销变分后验 q(alpha | x_t; phi) 的输出，该目标联合编码了任务性能和注意力机制的成本。这种设计产生了原则性的路由不确定性估计，用以控制软到硬路由的过渡，在没有临时负载均衡损失的情况下缓解了路由崩溃，并以微不足道的开销实现了比确定性或无先验学习路由更好的计算-性能权衡。在 Tiny LM 基准上的第一阶段实证结果证实了核心预测：贝叶斯控制器学习到的路由分布意味着在硬路由下投影的归一化 FLOP 成本为 25.1%，而无先验基线为 59.3%（降低了 34.2 个百分点），并将路由熵从 55.8% 降低到 43.3%（降低了 12.5 个百分点），表明狄利克雷先验防止了路由崩溃，而非贝叶斯模型则默认使用全注意力。我们展示了该贝叶斯架构、ELBO 训练目标以及一个验证了前向传播正确性、后验多样性以及针对无先验基线的对照消融实验的第一阶段 PyTorch 原型。代码开源于：https://github.com/KFEAL/meta-attention。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Meta-Attention，一种旨在提高Transformer推理效率的框架。该框架通过贝叶斯元控制器，将每个token动态地路由到最合适的注意力策略（全Softmax、线性或滑动窗口）。该控制器基于计算感知的狄利克雷先验进行后验推断，并利用联合优化任务性能与计算开销的ELBO目标进行训练。实验表明，该方法不仅能提供可靠的不确定性估计并防止路由崩溃，还能在Tiny LM基准上显著降低FLOPs成本（降至25.1%），实现更佳的计算-性能折中。
AI.keywords: 元注意力 (Meta-Attention), 贝叶斯路由 (Bayesian Routing), 变分推断 (Variational Inference), 动态注意力 (Dynamic Attention), 高效推理 (Efficient Inference)
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：将贝叶斯变分推断（特别是计算感知的狄利克雷先验）引入到Token级别的注意力机制路由中，提供了一种原则性的不确定性估计方法，非常新颖。
2. 重要性：成功解决了混合注意力模型中常见的“路由崩溃”（即模型倾向于退化到全注意力机制）问题，且无需设计复杂的启发式负载均衡损失。
3. 局限性：目前仅在Tiny LM（小语言模型）上进行了第一阶段（Phase 1）的验证，其在百亿/千亿参数规模的大语言模型（LLM）上的实际硬件加速效果和训练稳定性仍需进一步在大规模场景下检验。

title: CLANE: Continual Learning of Actions on Neuromorphic Hardware from Event Cameras
summary: Recognizing and continuously learning novel human actions without forgetting prior classes is a requirement for emerging AR/VR and robotics applications. For these applications, both on-device processing and learning are essential for privacy and low-latency adaptation. Event cameras address the efficiency of visual sensing with sparse, asynchronous output that is naturally compatible with neuromorphic processing. Yet no prior system has deployed a continual on-device learning pipeline for event-based action recognition using neuromorphic hardware. We present CLANE, Continual Learning of Actions on Neuromorphic Hardware from Event Cameras, deployed end-to-end on Intel Loihi 2. CLANE combines a spiking 2D CNN for spatiotemporal feature extraction with CLP-SNN as its on-chip learning head, extended to action clips via a Temporal Aggregation Layer and a fixed-point Normalization Layer, both novel Loihi 2 modules. On THU E-ACT-50, a 50-class dataset captured under real-world conditions, CLANE achieves 70.4% accuracy in a continual learning task while delivering more than 100x energy reduction and 16x lower latency over a sequential CNN+GRU+CLP edge GPU baseline, validated through iso-algorithm cross-platform benchmarking across three evaluation levels.

AI.title_translation: CLANE：基于事件相机的类脑硬件上动作的持续学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出并在Intel Loihi 2上端到端部署了CLANE系统，这是首个在类脑硬件上实现基于事件相机的动作识别持续学习系统，相比边缘GPU实现了超100倍的节能和16倍的低延迟。
AI.motivation: 在AR/VR和机器人等新兴应用中，设备端（on-device）持续学习新动作且不遗忘旧类别对于隐私保护和低延迟适应至关重要。虽然事件相机因其稀疏、异步的输出而与类脑处理天然兼容，但此前尚未有系统在类脑硬件上部署基于事件的动作识别持续设备端学习流水线。
AI.method: 提出CLANE系统，并将其端到端部署在Intel Loihi 2芯片上。CLANE结合了用于时空特征提取的脉冲2D CNN和作为片上学习头的CLP-SNN，并引入了两个全新的Loihi 2模块：时间聚合层（Temporal Aggregation Layer）和定点归一化层（fixed-point Normalization Layer），从而将网络处理能力扩展到动作视频剪辑。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集THU E-ACT-50（包含50个类别）上，CLANE在持续学习任务中实现了70.4%的准确率。与传统的顺序CNN+GRU+CLP边缘GPU基线相比，CLANE实现了超过100倍的能耗降低和16倍的低延迟，该结果通过跨三个评估级别的同算法跨平台基准测试得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: CLANE成功在Intel Loihi 2类脑芯片上实现了基于事件相机的端到端动作识别持续学习，在保证高准确率的同时，大幅降低了能耗和延迟，为AR/VR和机器人等边缘端应用提供了一种高效、隐私保护的解决方案。
AI.translation: 识别并持续学习新的人类动作且不遗忘先前的类别，是新兴AR/VR和机器人应用的一项要求。对于这些应用，设备端处理和学习对于隐私保护和低延迟适应至关重要。事件相机通过稀疏、异步的输出解决了视觉传感的效率问题，这与类脑（神经形态）处理天然兼容。然而，此前尚无系统在类脑硬件上部署用于基于事件的动作识别的持续设备端学习流水线。我们提出了CLANE，即基于事件相机的类脑硬件上动作的持续学习，并将其端到端部署在Intel Loihi 2上。CLANE将用于时空特征提取的脉冲2D CNN与作为其片上学习头的CLP-SNN相结合，并通过时间聚合层和定点归一化层（两者均为新颖的Loihi 2模块）扩展到动作视频剪辑。在真实世界条件下采集的50类数据集THU E-ACT-50上，CLANE在持续学习任务中实现了70.4%的准确率，同时相比顺序CNN+GRU+CLP边缘GPU基线，实现了超过100倍的能耗降低和16倍的更低延迟，这通过跨三个评估级别的同算法跨平台基准测试得到了验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CLANE，这是首个在Intel Loihi 2类脑硬件上端到端部署的、基于事件相机的动作识别持续学习系统。该系统通过结合脉冲2D CNN与CLP-SNN，并引入新颖的时间聚合层和定点归一化层，在50类真实世界数据集上实现了70.4%的持续学习准确率。与边缘GPU基线相比，CLANE不仅大幅降低了延迟，还将能耗降低了100倍以上。
AI.keywords: 持续学习, 类脑硬件, 事件相机, 动作识别, 脉冲神经网络
AI.comments:
1. 本文的创新性极高，首次在神经形态硬件（Intel Loihi 2）上实现了基于事件相机的端到端动作识别持续学习（Continual Learning）流水线。
2. 提出了时间聚合层（Temporal Aggregation Layer）和定点归一化层（fixed-point Normalization Layer）两个新颖的Loihi 2模块，成功解决了将SNN扩展到动作视频剪辑处理的难题。
3. 实验结果非常惊艳，在保持70.4%高准确率的同时，相比边缘GPU基线实现了超100倍的能耗降低和16倍的延迟降低，充分证明了类脑计算在边缘端、低功耗、低延迟场景下的巨大潜力。

title: Mechanistically Interpreting the Role of Sample Difficulty in RLVR for LLMs
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) is empirically shown to notably enhance the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), particularly in mathematics and programming. However, the mechanistic role of Sample Difficulty in RLVR remains poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate RLVR through the lens of difficulty-wise and one-sample analysis. We find that sample difficulty has a non-monotonic effect on RLVR: easy and medium-difficulty problems yield the strongest and most stable reasoning improvements, whereas overly hard problems often provide weak learning signals, induce degenerate behaviors such as answer repetition or skipping necessary computation, and can ultimately degrade the model's pre-existing capabilities. Beyond the obverse of response, we further analyze the model's internal feature dynamics using Temporal Sparse Autoencoders (T-SAE). Easy problems mainly reinforce direct-answer and basic-computation features while suppressing deliberative-reasoning features; hard problems activate reasoning-related features but become useful only when successful trajectories are sampled; medium-difficulty problems provide a more balanced signal, strengthening both computation and multi-step reasoning features. Motivated by these findings, we propose difficulty-adaptive strategies for hard-sample utilization, using backward-reasoning reformulation and T-SAE-guided training signals to improve reward density and credit assignment during RLVR. Overall, our results identify sample difficulty as a key factor governing both the optimization dynamics and representation evolution of RLVR.

AI.title_translation: 机械化解释样本难度在大语言模型可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中的作用
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了样本难度对大模型RLVR训练的非单调影响，指出中易难度样本最能稳定提升性能，而极难样本会导致模型退化；并利用稀疏自编码器分析了其内部特征演化，据此提出了难度自适应的训练策略。
AI.motivation: 尽管具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能显著提升大语言模型的数学和编程推理能力，但样本难度在RLVR中所起到的机理作用（mechanistic role）目前仍不清楚。
AI.method:
1. 采用难度维度（difficulty-wise）和单样本（one-sample）分析方法对RLVR进行评估。
2. 使用时间稀疏自编码器（T-SAE）剖析模型在处理不同难度样本时的内部特征动力学。
3. 提出难度自适应策略，包括逆向推理重构（backward-reasoning reformulation）和T-SAE引导的训练信号。
AI.result:
1. 样本难度对RLVR有非单调影响：简单和中等难度问题能带来最强、最稳定的推理提升；而过难的问题提供微弱的学习信号，容易诱发答案重复、跳过计算等退化行为，甚至损害模型原有能力。
2. T-SAE分析表明：简单问题强化直接回答和基础计算特征，抑制深思熟虑推理特征；困难问题能激活推理特征但极度依赖成功采样；中等难度问题能平衡并强化计算与多步推理特征。
AI.conclusion: 样本难度是决定RLVR优化动力学和表示演化的关键因素。通过难度自适应策略（如逆向推理重构和T-SAE引导信号），可以有效改善困难样本在RLVR中的利用率、奖励密度和信用分配。
AI.translation: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在实证上被证明能显著增强大语言模型（LLM）的推理性能，特别是在数学和编程领域。然而，样本难度在RLVR中的机理作用仍然知之甚少。在本文中，我们通过难度维度和单样本分析的视角来研究RLVR。我们发现样本难度对RLVR具有非单调的影响：简单和中等难度的题目带来了最强且最稳定的推理提升，而过难的题目通常提供微弱的学习信号，引发诸如答案重复或跳过必要计算等退化行为，并最终可能损害模型原有的能力。除了表面的回答反应外，我们还使用时间稀疏自编码器（T-SAE）进一步分析了模型的内部特征动力学。简单问题主要强化直接回答和基础计算特征，同时抑制深思熟虑的推理特征；困难问题激活了与推理相关的特征，但只有在采样到成功轨迹时才有用；中等难度的问题则提供了更平衡的信号，同时增强了计算和多步推理特征。基于这些发现，我们提出了用于困难样本利用的难度自适应策略，采用逆向推理重构和T-SAE引导的训练信号来提高RLVR期间的奖励密度和信用分配。总体而言，我们的结果表明样本难度是控制RLVR优化动力学和表示演化的关键因素。
AI.summary: 本文研究了样本难度对大语言模型在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中性能和内部表征的影响。研究表明，样本难度与RLVR效果呈非单调关系，中易难度样本对推理能力的提升最稳定，而过难样本会导致模型行为退化。通过时间稀疏自编码器（T-SAE）对模型内部特征的分析，作者揭示了不同难度样本激活特定计算和推理特征的机制，并据此提出了利用难样本的难度自适应策略。
AI.keywords: 可验证奖励强化学习 (RLVR), 样本难度 (Sample Difficulty), 机械化解释性 (Mechanistic Interpretability), 时间稀疏自编码器 (T-SAE), 大语言模型 (LLMs)
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于从可解释性（机理分析）的角度，结合时间稀疏自编码器（T-SAE），深入剖析了强化学习（RLVR）中样本难度对大模型内部表征和训练效果的非单调影响。这一发现打破了“训练样本越难越好”的盲目直觉，为大模型RL阶段的课程学习（Curriculum Learning）和数据选择提供了坚实的理论依据和改进方案。

title: FABSVer: Faster Training and Better Self-Verification for LLM Mathematical Reasoning
summary: While large language models have made significant progress in mathematical reasoning, they remain unreliable at judging the correctness of their own solutions. Existing approaches that equip models with self-verification typically treat solution generation and verification as two separate tasks, leading to substantially increased training time. In this paper, we propose FABSVer, which fuses these two tasks into a single generation pass, dramatically reducing training overhead while jointly optimizing both capabilities. We further identify a convergence bottleneck both theoretically and empirically: as training progresses, the reward reaches a plateau because the policy is constrained by a fixed reference model. To overcome this, we introduce Dynamic Reference Model Update (DRMU), which raises the reward ceiling and enables sustained reward growth. Extensive experiments on math benchmarks demonstrate that FABSVer achieves superior self-verification and reasoning performance across three model scales, while requiring only 51%--71% of the training time of existing methods. Analysis further reveals distinct learning phases in how models acquire self-verification, and that the gap between verify and answer rewards shrinks noticeably as model size increases.

AI.title_translation: FABSVer：针对大语言模型数学推理的更快训练与更好自我验证
AI.tldr: 本文提出 FABSVer，通过将生成与验证融合为单次生成并引入动态参考模型更新，在节省 29%--49% 训练时间的同时显著提升了 LLM 的数学推理和自我验证能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的赋予大语言模型自我验证能力的方法通常将“解答生成”和“验证”作为两个独立的任务进行训练，这导致了极大的训练时间开销。此外，在训练过程中，由于策略模型受到固定参考模型的约束，会导致奖励增长遇到瓶颈（达到平台期）。
AI.method: 1. 提出 FABSVer 方法，将解答生成和自我验证两个任务融合到单次生成中；2. 引入动态参考模型更新（DRMU）机制，通过动态更新参考模型来打破由于固定参考模型导致的奖励平台期，从而提升奖励上限。
AI.result: 在数学基准测试上的实验表明，FABSVer 在三种模型规模上均取得了优异的自我验证和推理表现，且其训练时间仅为现有方法的 51%--71%。此外，研究还发现随着模型规模增加，验证奖励与回答奖励之间的差距会明显缩小。
AI.conclusion: FABSVer 是一种高效且实用的方法，它成功地在降低 29%--49% 训练时间的同时，提升了大语言模型的数学推理和自我验证能力，并克服了传统训练中的收敛瓶颈。
AI.translation: 尽管大语言模型在数学推理方面取得了显著进展，但在判断自身解答正确性（即自我验证）方面仍不可靠。现有的赋予模型自我验证能力的方法通常将解答生成和验证视为两个独立的任务，导致训练时间大幅增加。在本文中，我们提出了 FABSVer，它将这两个任务融合到单次生成过程中，在共同优化这两种能力的同时，极大地减少了训练开销。我们还在理论和实证上确定了一个收敛瓶颈：随着训练的进行，由于策略受到固定参考模型的约束，奖励会达到平台期。为了克服这一问题，我们引入了动态参考模型更新（DRMU），它提高了奖励上限并实现了持续的奖励增长。在数学基准上进行的大量实验表明，FABSVer 在三种模型规模上均实现了优异的自我验证和推理性能，同时仅需要现有方法 51%--71% 的训练时间。分析进一步揭示了模型获取自我验证能力的独特学习阶段，并且随着模型规模的增加，验证和回答奖励之间的差距明显缩小。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型数学推理中自我验证训练成本高及奖励收敛瓶颈的问题，提出了 FABSVer。该方法通过将生成与验证融合为单次生成过程来减少训练开销，并利用动态参考模型更新（DRMU）机制突破奖励上限。实验表明，该方法在显著缩减训练时间的同时，有效提升了多尺度模型的推理与自我验证性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 数学推理, 自我验证, 动态参考模型更新, 训练效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将原本分离的解答生成和自我验证任务合并为单次生成过程，从而大幅降低了训练开销。同时，针对强化学习中固定参考模型导致的奖励瓶颈，设计了动态参考模型更新（DRMU）机制，为持续提升模型性能提供了新思路。局限性在于该方法目前仅在数学推理基准上进行了验证，其在更广泛的推理或生成任务中的普适性仍有待观察。

title: You Live More Than Once: Towards Hierarchical Skill Meta-Evolving
summary: Test-time skill evolving is regarded as a new paradigm for enhancing deployed agentic systems. Existing works mainly focus on hard-coded skill evolving strategies or parametric learning that rely on expensive parameter updates in the underlying LLMs. In this paper, we demonstrate that test-time refinement of the skill evolving framework itself is necessary for continuous improvement of the agent systems in different downstream scenarios, and lightweight algorithmic adaptation is feasible. Specifically, we propose HiSME, a lightweight hierarchical skill meta-evolving solution that jointly optimizes skills and the skill evolving strategy by learning meta-skills from agents' task execution traces. Experiments on diverse agentic benchmarks show that meta-evolving can produce a higher-quality skill library than pure skill evolving and can derive diverse meta-skills for different scenarios, thereby facilitating future continual experience learning. Our code is temporarily public at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HiSME-BD45.

AI.title_translation: 你不只活一次：走向分层技能元演化
AI.tldr: 本文提出HiSME，一种通过从执行轨迹中学习元技能来联合优化技能和演化策略的轻量级分层元演化方案，显著提升了智能体的持续学习能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体技能演化方法主要依赖于硬编码的演化策略或昂贵的LLM参数更新。为了让智能体在不同的下游场景中持续改进，需要一种在测试时能够对技能演化框架本身进行轻量级算法自适应调整的方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为HiSME的轻量级分层技能元演化方案。该方案通过从智能体的任务执行轨迹中学习“元技能”，从而实现技能本身与技能演化策略的联合优化。
AI.result: 在多种智能体基准测试上的实验表明，相比于单纯的技能演化，HiSME元演化方案能够产生更高质量的技能库，并能针对不同场景衍生出多样化的元技能，从而有效促进未来的持续经验学习。
AI.conclusion: 测试时对技能演化框架本身进行精炼（元演化）是实现智能体系统在不同下游场景中持续改进的关键，且通过HiSME这种轻量级的分层元演化方案是完全可行和有效的。
AI.translation: 测试时技能演化被认为是增强已部署智能体系统的一种新范式。现有工作主要集中在硬编码的技能演化策略或依赖于底层大语言模型（LLM）昂贵参数更新的参数化学习上。在本文中，我们证明了为了在不同的下游场景中持续改进智能体系统，对技能演化框架本身进行测试时精炼是必要的，且轻量级的算法自适应是可行的。具体而言，我们提出了 HiSME，一种轻量级的分层技能元演化解决方案，该方案通过从智能体的任务执行轨迹中学习元技能，来共同优化技能和技能演化策略。在不同智能体基准上的实验表明，与纯粹的技能演化相比，元演化可以产生更高质量的技能库，并能针对不同场景衍生出多样化的元技能，从而促进未来的持续经验学习。我们的代码临时公开在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HiSME-BD45。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有智能体技能演化方法成本高、灵活性差的问题，提出了HiSME——一种轻量级的分层技能元演化方案。该方法通过从任务执行轨迹中学习元技能，实现了技能与演化策略的协同优化。实验证明，HiSME能显著提升技能库质量并生成适应多场景的元技能，为智能体持续学习奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 技能演化, 元学习, 智能体系统, 持续学习, 层次化架构
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将“元学习（Meta-Learning）”的思想引入到智能体的技能演化中，不仅优化技能本身，还联合优化了技能演化策略，避免了传统方法对硬编码策略或昂贵LLM参数微调的依赖。这为实现低成本、自适应的智能体持续学习提供了一条新路径。其局限性在于，由于仅基于摘要，尚不清楚该方法在面对极度异构的任务场景时的泛化能力边界，以及对底层LLM推理能力的具体依赖程度。

title: Bound-Constrained Sparse Representation for Electrical Impedance Tomography
summary: This study proposes a bound-constrained sparse representation (BC-SR) framework for electrical impedance tomography (EIT), aimed at improving conductivity estimation without explicit regularization. BC-SR adopts a representation-driven strategy, generating conductivity from low-dimensional latent variables via an implicit composite parameterization. Structural priors are embedded using a truncated graph-Laplacian basis, while a bound-preserving nonlinear mapping enforces admissible conductivity ranges and improves conditioning through implicit gradient modulation. The approach ensures robust convergence, even under noisy or incomplete data. Extensive validation on 2D/3D simulations, tank experiments, and in-vivo lung data shows that BC-SR improves physical consistency and structural fidelity, offering enhanced robustness compared to traditional methods. Additionally, BC-SR enables 3D time-difference EIT reconstruction, offering improved spatial resolution and a more coherent representation of 3D conductivity distributions, particularly for in-vivo lung data. This suggests potential for improved performance in EIT, particularly in clinical applications for respiratory monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 电阻抗断层成像的边界约束稀疏表示
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种边界约束稀疏表示（BC-SR）框架，无需显式正则化即可显著提升电阻抗断层成像（EIT）的电导率重建精度、鲁棒性和空间分辨率。
AI.motivation: 旨在改进电阻抗断层成像（EIT）中的电导率估计，在无需显式正则化的前提下提高重建的物理一致性、结构保真度以及面对噪声或不完整数据时的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出了一种边界约束稀疏表示（BC-SR）框架。该框架采用表征驱动策略，通过隐式复合参数化从低维隐变量生成电导率；使用截断图拉普拉斯（graph-Laplacian）基嵌入结构先验；并利用保持边界的非线性映射强制约束电导率范围，通过隐式梯度调制改善条件数。
AI.result: 在2D/3D仿真、水槽实验和体内肺部数据上的验证表明，BC-SR相比传统方法显著提高了物理一致性和结构保真度，具有更强的鲁棒性。此外，该方法成功实现了3D时差EIT重建，提供了更高的空间分辨率和更连贯的3D电导率分布表示（尤其在体内肺部数据中）。
AI.conclusion: BC-SR框架在提高EIT成像性能方面表现出巨大潜力，特别是在呼吸监测等临床应用中具有重要的实用价值。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了一种用于电阻抗断层成像（EIT）的边界约束稀疏表示（BC-SR）框架，旨在无需显式正则化的情况下改进电导率估计。BC-SR采用表征驱动策略，通过隐式复合参数化从低维隐变量生成电导率。利用截断图拉普拉斯基嵌入结构先验，同时利用保持边界的非线性映射来强制约束允许的电导率范围，并通过隐式梯度调制来改善条件数。该方法确保了即使在噪声或不完整数据下也能实现鲁棒的收敛。在2D/3D仿真、水槽实验和体内肺部数据上的广泛验证表明，BC-SR提高了物理一致性和结构保真度，与传统方法相比提供了更强的鲁棒性。此外，BC-SR还实现了3D时差EIT重建，提供了更高的空间分辨率和更连贯的3D电导率分布表示，特别是在体内肺部数据中。这表明其在提高EIT性能方面具有潜力，特别是在呼吸监测的临床应用中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于电阻抗断层成像（EIT）的边界约束稀疏表示（BC-SR）框架。该方法通过隐式复合参数化和截断图拉普拉斯基引入结构先验，并利用非线性映射进行电导率的边界约束，从而在无需显式正则化的前提下实现鲁棒的电导率重建。实验表明，该方法在2D/3D成像及临床肺部监测中具有优异的重构精度和物理一致性。
AI.keywords: 电阻抗断层成像, 边界约束, 稀疏表示, 图像重建, 肺部监测
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将边界约束与稀疏表示相结合，用于解决EIT这一高度非线性和病态的逆问题。其通过隐式复合参数化和隐式梯度调制，避免了传统方法对显式正则化的依赖，同时有效引入了结构先验并约束了物理边界。在3D时差重建和体内肺部数据上的成功应用，展示了其在临床呼吸监测中的巨大实用潜力。

title: Sketch2Motion: Text-driven 2D Sketch to 3D Animation via Diffusion-guided Skeleton Optimization
summary: Animation of 2D hand-drawn sketches provides an effective medium for visual communication. However, these sketches pose challenges, particularly in handling occlusions and accurately mapping motion. While 3D animation naturally addresses these challenges, estimating 3D motion remains a very complex task. Recent approaches to converting 2D sketches to 3D animations have mainly focused on specific types of motion, such as bipedal movements and facial expressions. We propose Sketch2Motion, a diffusion-guided framework for skeleton-based motion synthesis that combines classical character animation pipelines with deep generative priors. Our method represents motion using skeletal transformations, which are propagated to mesh deformations via linear blend skinning. To guide the resulting animation toward realistic and semantically meaningful motion, we integrate a text-to-video diffusion model via motion-aware score-distillation sampling (MoSDS), enabling optimization without paired motion data. Additionally, we apply physics-inspired smoothness, topological, and contact constraints to stabilize optimization and preserve motion plausibility. Further, we integrate a spring-mass simulator to introduce secondary motion effects. The proposed framework is generalized, fully differentiable, modular, and compatible with biped, quadruped, and non-living articulated characters. Experiments demonstrate that our approach produces temporally coherent, text-aligned animations that outperform baseline motion transfer methods that lack generative priors or explicit physical constraints. We will make our code and dataset publicly available.

title: ADWIN: Adaptive Windows for Horizon-Aware On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers reasoning behavior by training a student on teacher feedback along student-generated trajectories, but standard full-rollout training ties every update to a costly completion and can over-allocate supervision to late positions with low marginal value for the current student. We revisit this assumption through the useful supervision horizon: student-induced rollouts can drift from teacher-preferred continuations, while aligned prefixes may already preserve the long-horizon OPD update direction. We propose ADWIN, an adaptive-window framework for OPD that treats rollout length as an online admissibility decision, training on short teacher-anchored prefixes while using delayed full-rollout probes to audit prefix--full alignment and adapt the next horizon with staleness control. Across math and code reasoning benchmarks in single-task, multi-task, and strong-to-weak settings, ADWIN improves the accuracy--compute trade-off over full-rollout OPD and prefix-based baselines, reducing end-to-end training cost by up to 4.1 times while achieving comparable or better accuracy.

title: Adaptive Temporal Gating of Longitudinal Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Alzheimer's Prediction
summary: Predicting conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) to Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is critical for early intervention. Current deep learning paradigms predominantly rely on cross-sectional structural MRI, neglecting prognostic value in patient-specific anatomical trajectories. We introduce the Temporal Adaptive Fusion Network (TAF-Net), a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture that models paired longitudinal 3D MRI scans. Central to TAF-Net is a Temporal Fusion Module governed by an Adaptive Temporal Gate, which learns patient-specific weightings to synthesize three spatiotemporal representations: explicit structural change, region-to-region temporal cross-attention, and bilateral feature concatenation. Evaluated on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort for three-year MCI-to-AD conversion prediction, TAF-Net achieved the highest discriminative performance among all evaluated methods using only structural MRI, significantly outperforming the strongest baseline and approaching multimodal methods requiring PET, CSF, or genetic data. The architecture exhibited exceptional data efficiency, matching baseline performance with a fraction of training data. Ablation studies demonstrate that longitudinal fusion improves discrimination while reducing predictive variance by 48% compared to single-timepoint evaluation. Interpretability analyses reveal spatial attention aligned with established AD pathology in the medial temporal lobe and ventricles, while the gating mechanism prioritizes explicit volumetric change with strong positive correlation to conversion risk.

title: HRBench: Benchmarking and Understanding Thinking-Mode Switch Strategies in Hybrid-Reasoning LLMs
summary: Hybrid-reasoning large language models (LLMs) expose explicit controls over reasoning effort, allowing users or systems to trade off answer quality against inference cost. However, existing methods for adaptive thinking-mode selection are typically evaluated under different models, datasets, and implementation assumptions, making it difficult to compare their practical behavior. We introduce HRBench, a unified evaluation framework for studying thinking-mode switching in hybrid-reasoning LLMs. HRBench organizes the design space along two axes: three switching strategy families, prompt-based selection, external routing, and speculative execution, and four training regimes, training-free, SFT, offline and online RL, yielding 12 controlled evaluation settings. We evaluate these settings across 6 LLMs, from Qwen3.5-2B to Kimi-K2.5-1.1T, and 5 reasoning benchmarks covering mathematics, science, and code, while reimplementing 12+ representative prior methods within the same pipeline. Our analysis characterizes how different switching strategies occupy distinct effectiveness-efficiency trade-off regions: prompt-based methods often provide favorable token-accuracy trade-offs, routing methods offer more stable cost reduction, and speculative methods tend to improve accuracy at higher token cost. We further find that training affects strategies differently, and that the preferred strategy varies with model scale and task domain. HRBench provides reference implementations and a unified evaluation platform to support more controlled research on efficient reasoning in hybrid-reasoning LLMs. Our data, code and repository are available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/HRBench.

title: Information Age-Controllability Trade-offs in Communication-Constrained Networks
summary: We investigate the trade-off between controllability, channel access, and age-related performance in a wireless network of control systems. Controllers share a random-access channel to transmit control inputs to actuators over slotted blocks. We measure reliable control via block controllability, where a block is controllable if it contains a required number of consecutive successful transmissions. In parallel, we capture information freshness via the age of information. To enable efficient allocation of channel resources over time, we introduce adaptive access probabilities at the block level, prioritizing controllers that have not yet achieved controllability. We then derive closed-form expressions for block controllability probability, the peak latency between inter-block consecutive successes, and peak age of information. We further characterize the peak control latency, defined as the time between consecutive controllable blocks. Finally, we optimize access probabilities to jointly balance controllability and age-related metrics. Numerical results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed adaptive access policies in managing this trade-off in interference-limited wireless control networks.

title: TrioSeq: A Novel Approach to Accelerate Triplet Sequence Alignment on GPUs
comments: published on IPDPS '26 (2026 International Parallel & Distributed Processing Symposium)
summary: State-of-the-art multiple sequence alignment (MSA) algorithms are based on progressive approaches that rely on pairwise sequence alignment (PSA) to generate guide trees to align all sequences. Given an evidenced explosion in genomic data availability, research efforts have focused on accelerating PSA on massively-parallel architectures (e.g., GPUs) and specialized hardware (e.g., FPGAs). However, there is increasing evidence that starting from exact 3-way alignments could provide more robust, accurate MSAs, and improve genomic analysis. While the current literature has shown that PSA algorithms can be extended to align sequence triplets, the existent state-of-the-art on hardware acceleration of exact 3-way alignments is still scarce. In particular, current GPU methods are still inefficient due to lacking support for novel hardware features (e.g., cross-thread intrinsics), while being closed-source and vendor-specific. In this paper, TrioSeq is proposed as a fine-grained strategy to efficiently implement 3-way alignments on GPUs, leveraging novel levels of GPU parallelism and synchronization to achieve high throughput in aligning sequence triplets. Evaluation on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs shows that TrioSeq outperforms state-of-the-art GPU progressive methods on 3-way alignment by at least 20% on simulated genomic datasets.
comment: published on IPDPS '26 (2026 International Parallel & Distributed Processing Symposium)

title: EgoRelight: Egocentric Human Capture and Illumination Recovery for Relightable and Photoreal Avatar Rendering
summary: Mixed Reality (MR) headsets promise a future of immersive telepresence where virtual humans blend indistinguishably into real or virtual surroundings. Achieving this vision requires a method for capturing a user's motion, estimating appearance under novel lighting, and understanding the environment - all from the constrained viewpoint of a head-mounted display (HMD). Existing approaches treat these as isolated problems: they either focus on driving avatars with baked-in lighting or rely on studio setups for relighting. In this paper, we present EgoRelight, a holistic framework for egocentric telepresence that simultaneously captures full-body human performance, synthesizes photorealistic and relightable appearance, and estimates high dynamic range (HDR) environment maps from a single HMD. First, to ensure motion and surface reconstruction, we propose an egocentric perception module that leverages stereo down-facing cameras to extract dense depth maps, which serve as geometric control signals to drive a mesh-based avatar. Second, we introduce a novel neural appearance model that learns to synthesize view-dependent specular and view-independent diffuse shading separately. By employing a specialized ray-sampling strategy, our model generalizes to unseen illumination without relying on restrictive analytical BRDF priors. Third, we enable seamless avatar integration into the physical world via a test-time inverse rendering process, which recovers an HDR environment map by matching the pre-trained avatar's appearance to live egocentric camera observations. We demonstrate our system through a social telepresence application, where remote users are coherently relit according to their physical environment. Extensive experiments show that our components and the integrated system significantly outperform state-of-the-art baselines in geometric accuracy and rendering as well as relighting fidelity.

title: Measuring Progress Toward AGI: A Cognitive Framework
summary: Despite widespread discussion of AGI, there is no clear framework for measuring progress toward it. This ambiguity fuels subjective claims, makes it difficult to track progress, and risks hindering responsible governance. As a starting point to address this gap, we present a framework for understanding system capabilities in relation to human cognitive abilities. Drawing from decades of research in psychology, neuroscience, and cognitive science, we introduce a Cognitive Taxonomy that deconstructs general intelligence into 10 key cognitive faculties. We then propose a rigorous evaluation protocol in which a system's performance is measured across a suite of targeted, held-out cognitive tasks, generating a 'cognitive profile' that can be used to understand a system's strengths and weaknesses. We hope this framework will provide a practical roadmap and an initial step toward more rigorous, empirical evaluation of AGI.

title: Efficient Post-training of LLMs for Code Generation With Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Post-training using online reinforcement learning (RL) is an important training step for LLMs, including code-generating models. However, online RL for code generation involves LLM inference and verification of the generated output, which can take considerable time and resources. In this paper, we explore the application of offline RL to code-generating models by leveraging existing code datasets. Our experiments demonstrate that offline RL is an effective training strategy for improving LLM performance. We show that offline RL can be especially beneficial for small LLMs and challenging coding problems.

title: Tactile-Proprioceptive Sensor Fusion for Contact Wrench Estimation in Whole-Body Physical Human-Robot Interaction
comments: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026
summary: Direct physical guidance is a natural means of teaching and interacting with robots, and robotic skins make a key contribution by enabling sensitive contact sensing and localization. This paper presents a tactile-proprioceptive sensor fusion framework for natural physical human-robot interaction. Tactile cues from pneumatic skin pads serve as contact indicators that bypass the ambiguity between frictional residues and applied external forces, enabling highly sensitive contact detection without explicit friction identification. We fuse these cues with motor-current-based proprioception to reconstruct multi-axis contact forces on the robot surface. To maintain accuracy during motion, we employ a temporal convolutional network (TCN) to mitigate friction hysteresis during stick-slip transitions, reducing uncertainty at contact onset and yielding smooth, responsive guidance. We validate the approach on a skin-integrated robot arm: (i) multi-axis forces are reconstructed in stationary contacts, and (ii) simultaneous force estimation and kinesthetic teaching are demonstrated. Results indicate improved sensitivity and responsiveness across diverse contact conditions compared with tactile-only and proprioceptive-only baselines, supporting tactile-proprioceptive fusion as a reliable pathway to safe, intuitive physical human-robot interaction.
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026

title: Statistical comparison of reconstruction methods for the inverse boundary problem of the one-dimensional wave equation
summary:
Several numerical reconstruction algorithms for the inverse boundary value problem of the 1-dimensional wave equation exist. In this paper we revisit two of them, the Sondhi-Gopinath (SG) method from 1971 and the Korpela-Lassas-Oksanen (KLO) method from 2016. The former is stable enough that it was used in practical applications. The latter has a regularisation scheme with a theoretical proof, and is an evolution of the boundary control method. Both are based on the idea of constructing solutions that are characteristic functions of a set at a given time. This similarity has been pointed out before, but no systematic comparison has been published.
  We compare the performance of the two algorithms with noisy simulated data. The application in our minds is reconstructing the internal cross-sectional area of a pressurised fluid pipe which corresponds to the first order $\partial_x$ term of the wave equation. Instead of just observing the performance on a few test cases, we generate $n=1000$ random area profiles of various smoothness levels and measurement noise up to $10\%$ of the signal energy and perform statistical tests. SG and KLO have a difference of one time-derivative in their standard boundary data, which complicates the analysis. Our results show that SG performs better in the low noise regime, and KLO with high noise. SG is easier to implement and runs faster.

title: Revisiting Metafeatures to Explain Model Differences on Tabular Data
summary: With the rise of tabular foundation models alongside traditional models still performing well on many tasks, choosing the right model for a tabular dataset remains difficult. We investigate whether dataset meta-features can explain performance gaps between model families on tabular prediction tasks. Using the TabArena benchmark results, we analyze dataset-level performance gaps and relate them to model-agnostic dataset descriptors. After strict statistical tests with false discovery control, we find that (1) for neural network vs. tree gaps, no meta-feature survives false discovery control, (2) for non-foundation vs. foundation model gaps, one association is robust but does not generalize when tested in leave-one-dataset-out prediction, and (3) for TabICLv2 vs. TabPFN-2.6, one robust association also improves held-out prediction. Furthermore, we conduct a leave-one-dataset-out analysis and find that meta-feature predictors fail to improve meaningfully over a simple baseline. Overall, our results show the heterogeneity of tabular datasets and that global meta-feature approaches are not robust enough to offer explanations on the 51 TabArena datasets.

title: Conveyance: A Versatile Framework for Learning in Structured Class Spaces
summary: While machine learning (ML) architectures have evolved rapidly to account for complex data, loss functions like cross-entropy remain mostly structure-agnostic in many real-world applications. However, the `class-symmetric' nature of these standard losses fundamentally limits the ability of ML models to exploit structural relationships between classes, particularly when facing structured noise. We propose \textsc{Conveyance}, a new classification approach and associated loss function tailored to structured class spaces. It allows users to encode graph-like relations between classes without having to define complex joint distributions or manually tune utility matrices.Technically, our loss function operates by maximizing two separate margins over distinct class partitions, while preserving formal properties such as monotonicity and partial convexity. We demonstrate the versatility and effectiveness of our method by applying it to hierarchical classification, ordinal regression, and multiple instance learning. Across these tasks, \textsc{Conveyance} either matches or exceeds the performance of specialized baselines, thereby offering a unified solution for structured class spaces.

title: DenoiseRL: Bootstrapping Reasoning Models to Recover from Noisy Prefixes
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for advancing reasoning in large language models, yet most existing methods still depend on stronger teacher models or heavily curated difficult datasets, limiting scalable capability improvement. In this paper, we introduce DenoiseRL, a reinforcement learning framework that substitutes external supervision with recovery-oriented optimization over failures from weak models.
